items.title: 〈房產〉六都預售屋市場結構重組 台北價量齊躍升 高雄交易量慘減半
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Six Metropolitan Areas Restructure Pre-sale Housing Market: Taipei Prices and Volume Surge, Kaohsiung Volume Halved
paras: 全台房市仍冰冷，但由房仲業者統計顯示，2026年1-6月的全台六都預售案交易案件，唯有台北市平交易量年增4.2%，交易價格上漲高達7%。而交易量萎縮最為嚴重的高雄，交易件數則呈現腰斬，下滑高達50.2%

中信房屋研展室彙整實價登錄資料，對比六都2025年上半年與2026年上半年預售屋市場表現，台北市平均房價上漲7%、交易量增加4.2%，新北市平均房價上漲4.4%、交易量減少5.5%，桃園市平均房價上漲2.4%、交易量減少21.6%，台中市平均房價上漲1.5、交易量減少24.9%，台南市平均房價上漲3.1%、交易量減少23.6%，高雄市平均房價上漲1.9%、交易量減少50.2%，整體而言，六都預售房價仍維持上行趨勢，成交量卻普遍下滑，僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的局面。
中信房屋研展室副理莊思敏指出，從六都數據來看，當前預售市場已從過去的熱絡行情，逐步轉向「價格有撐、交易量收斂」的格局。房價方面，在土地成本、營造成本仍處於高檔的情況下，建商讓利空間相對有限，因此價格並未出現修正。然而，在交易量方面，受到信用管制與房貸資金環境影響，市場觀望氣氛瀰漫，買方心態轉趨保守，購屋決策時間也相應拉長，進而使得市場成交動能受到壓抑，交易量同步走弱。
莊思敏示，六都中僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的態勢，主要是因為台北市寸土寸金、土地供給有限、新屋供不應求，加上住宅市場客群多元，除了自住需求之外，也有一定比例的資產配置及長期置產需求，因此即使整體市況降溫，台北市仍能展現相對穩健的韌性。
相較之下，桃園、台中、台南及高雄等地的預售屋交易量則出現了較為明顯的量縮，以上區域的新建案多集中於新興重劃區或蛋白區，雖具備重大建設、交通項目或產業進駐等長期利多，惟部分區塊的生活機能仍處於起步階段，而房價卻已超前反映未來願景，如今隨著市場回歸剛性需求，買方出手更加謹慎，追價意願大幅降低，交易量自然隨之縮減。
莊思敏表示，目前房市仍處於盤整期，建議消費者應保持理性，審慎評估自身需求和財務狀況，避免盲目追價。此外，由於交易量持續走低、建商資金周轉壓力加重，市面上偶有建商財務危機或工程延宕的消息出現，消費者在挑選預售案時，務必要多加留意建商口碑與履約能力，以降低交易風險。
paras_en: The nationwide housing market remains cold, but data from real‑estate agents shows that for pre‑sale projects in the six major cities during the first half of 2026, only Taipei City recorded a 4.2% year‑over‑year increase in transaction volume and a price jump of up to 7%. In Kaohsiung, where the decline was most severe, the number of transactions was cut in half, dropping 50.2%.

The research department of CTBC Real Estate compiled official transaction‑price data and compared the pre‑sale market performance of the six cities between the first half of 2025 and the first half of 2026. Taipei’s average price rose 7% with a 4.2% rise in volume; New Taipei’s average price rose 4.4% while volume fell 5.5%; Taoyuan’s average price rose 2.4% with volume down 21.6%; Taichung’s average price rose 1.5% with volume down 24.9%; Tainan’s average price rose 3.1% with volume down 23.6%; Kaohsiung’s average price rose 1.9% with volume down 50.2%. Overall, pre‑sale prices in the six cities kept climbing, but transaction volumes generally fell, with only Taipei showing a “price‑and‑volume increase” scenario.

Zhuang Simin, deputy manager of CTBC Real Estate’s research department, said that the data from the six cities indicate the pre‑sale market has shifted from a previously hot climate to a pattern of “prices holding up while transaction volume contracts.” With land and construction costs still high, developers have limited room to cut prices, so prices have not been corrected. However, transaction volume is being squeezed by credit controls and the mortgage funding environment, creating a pervasive wait‑and‑see mood. Buyers are becoming more conservative and taking longer to decide, which dampens market momentum and weakens volume.

Zhuang noted that only Taipei still shows a “price‑and‑volume increase” because the city’s land is extremely scarce, supply of new homes cannot meet demand, and the residential market serves a diverse clientele. Besides owner‑occupiers, there is a sizable segment of investors and long‑term property‑placement demand, so even as overall conditions cool, Taipei can still demonstrate relatively robust resilience.

In contrast, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung have seen a more pronounced contraction in pre‑sale transaction volume. New projects in these areas are largely concentrated in emerging redevelopment zones or “egg‑white” districts that, while promising major infrastructure, transport projects or industry entry in the long run, still have nascent living‑amenity infrastructure. Prices have already priced in future expectations, and as the market returns to rigid demand, buyers are far more cautious, their willingness to chase prices has dropped sharply, and transaction volume has naturally shrunk.

Zhuang said the housing market remains in a consolidation phase and advised consumers to stay rational, carefully assess their own needs and financial situation, and avoid blindly chasing prices. Moreover, as transaction volumes continue to fall and developers face tighter cash flow, occasional news of developer financial distress or project delays emerges. Buyers should therefore pay close attention to a developer’s reputation and ability to fulfill contracts when selecting pre‑sale projects, to reduce transaction risk.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉資本利得配息占比逾9成 00881、00878除息前夕爆大量
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Capital Gains Distribution Ratio Exceeds 90% for 00881 and 00878 Before Dividend Payment
paras: 科技大廠財報與營運數據陸續報喜，帶動市場資金持續湧入台股。國泰投信旗下 2 檔高人氣 ETF—國泰台灣科技龍頭(00881-TW)與國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)即將於明(18)日正式除息，今(17)日為參與本次收益分配的最後買進日，由於 2 檔資本利得配息占比均突破 9 成，吸引買盤強勢卡位，00881 盤中成交量衝破 5 萬張，00878 更爆出逾 8.6 萬張大量，雙雙展現強勁交投氣勢。
據國泰投信公告，00881 本次每單位預計配發 4.6 元，00878 每單位則配發 1.01 元。受高額配息與 AI 題材激勵，兩檔 ETF 人氣同步飆升，自 7 月底公告預估配息以來，00881 單周受益人數增加約 1.5 萬人，00878 受益人數亦大增逾 1.1 萬人，顯示市場關注度持續居高不下。
針對市場關注的「收益分配來源」，00881 基金經理人蘇鼎宇表示，根據官方公布之組成占比，00881 本次配息中，已實現資本利得高達 98.91%，股利所得僅占 1.09%；而 00878 基金經理人江宇騰亦指出，00878 本次資本利得占比同樣高達 90.10%，股利所得占 9.90%。
蘇鼎宇分析，配息主要來自基金投資部位累積並實現的資本利得，充分反映近年台灣科技龍頭股價成長的成果。依現行稅制，個人投資人取得之已實現資本利得免納所得稅，且不計入二代健保補充保費。兩檔 ETF 配息結構皆有逾 9 成來自資本利得，成為吸引投資人青睞的一大稅務亮點(實際課稅仍依投資人個別身分及相關法令規定為準)。
在基本面表現上，蘇鼎宇進一步指出，近期科技龍頭營運成績為 AI 產業提供強烈支撐。台積電 7 月營收再創單月新高；鴻海公布第二季財報，單季營收達新台幣 2.53 兆元，稅後淨利約 600 億元、年增 35%，營收與獲利均創歷年同期新高，展現 AI 伺服器的強勁需求。
隨著全球 AI 投資從資本支出擴張進入「獲利驗證」階段，市場焦點已轉向企業能否將需求轉化為實質營收。台灣科技供應鏈憑藉完整的產業聚落與技術優勢，長線仍將是全球 AI 發展趨勢下的最大受惠者。

paras_en: The technology giant's financial reports and operating data have been released one after another, driving continuous capital inflows into the Taiwan Stock Exchange. Two popular ETFs under Cathay Securities Investment Trust, Cathay Taiwan Tech Leaders (00881-TW) and Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878-TW), are scheduled to officially pay dividends on August 18. Today, August 17, is the last trading day for participating in this round of profit distribution. Due to the two ETFs' capital gains distribution ratio exceeding 90%, they have attracted strong buying pressure, with 00881's trading volume exceeding 50,000 shares and 00878's trading volume reaching over 86,000 shares, both showing strong trading momentum.

According to Cathay Securities Investment Trust's announcement, 00881 is expected to distribute NT$4.6 per unit, while 00878 is expected to distribute NT$1.01 per unit. With high dividend payments and AI-themed attractions, the two ETFs' popularity has skyrocketed simultaneously. Since the announcement of estimated dividend payments in late July, 00881 has gained approximately 15,000 new investors, while 00878 has gained over 11,000 new investors, indicating that market attention remains high.

Regarding the market's concern about 'profit distribution sources', Cathay Taiwan Tech Leaders' fund manager, Su Ding-yu, stated that, based on the official composition ratio, 00881's capital gains distribution ratio for this round of dividend payment reached 98.91%, while the dividend income accounted for only 1.09%. Similarly, Cathay Sustainable High Dividend's fund manager, Jiang Yu-teng, pointed out that 00878's capital gains distribution ratio also reached 90.10%, while the dividend income accounted for 9.90%.

Su Ding-yu analyzed that the dividend payment mainly comes from the accumulated and realized capital gains from the fund's investment portfolio, fully reflecting the growth of Taiwan's tech leaders' stock prices in recent years. Under the current tax system, individual investors who have realized capital gains are exempt from income tax, and the gains are not included in the supplementary premium for the second-generation national health insurance. Both ETFs have more than 90% of their dividend payments coming from capital gains, making them a significant tax advantage for investors.

From a fundamental perspective, Su Ding-yu further pointed out that the recent operating performance of tech leaders has provided strong support for the AI industry. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) reported a new high in July sales, while Hon Hai Group announced its second-quarter financial report, with a single-quarter revenue of NT$253 billion and a net profit of NT$60 billion, a year-on-year increase of 35%. Both revenue and profit reached new highs, demonstrating the strong demand for AI servers.

As global AI investment has expanded from capital expenditure to the 'profit verification' stage, the market's focus has shifted to whether companies can convert demand into actual revenue. Taiwan's technology supply chain, with its complete industry cluster and technological advantages, will continue to be the biggest beneficiary of the global AI development trend in the long run.

items.title: 國籍航空唯一 華航連4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎
items.title_en: EVA Air Wins Asia's Best Employer for 4th Consecutive Year
paras: 2026 年亞洲最佳企業雇主獎(HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia)評比結果出爐，華航(2610-TW)再度脫穎而出，蟬聯四屆「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」殊榮，為唯一連續獲獎的國籍航空。
「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」是亞洲人力資源領域最具指標性的年度評選之一，也為衡量企業雇主品牌的重要標竿，今年台灣區共有 330 家企業參選，華航於激烈評選中再創佳績，連續四年抱回「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」。
此次評選中，華航於「組織團隊」指標表現尤為亮眼，獲得最高分數，充分反映員工對公司團隊合作氛圍、組織凝聚力和整體工作環境的高度認同及肯定。
華航表示，視員工為公司最重要的資產，提供具市場競爭力的薪資，以及優待機票、員工持股信託等多元福利制度，今年持續以「工作生活平衡」為核心，舉辦員工日 Open House 系列活動及健康紓壓日，邀請同仁與眷屬參訪華航園區及修護工廠，促進親子關係，照顧員工身心健康與生活品質。
同時，華航深耕人才培育，規劃職能訓練課程，鼓勵員工發揮專業潛能，並透過多方溝通機制及 ESG 人才永續策略，建立開放共融的職場文化。
隨著全新 787 機隊即將加入營運，華航正持續推動人力招募計畫，提前布局未來所需人才。
paras_en: EVA Air (2610-TW) has emerged as the winner of the 2026 Asia's Best Employer award (HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia) for the fourth consecutive year, making it the only national carrier to achieve this feat.

The Asia's Best Employer award is one of the most prestigious annual awards in the human resources field in Asia, and serves as an important benchmark for measuring a company's employer brand. This year, a total of 330 companies in Taiwan participated in the competition, with EVA Air emerging victorious once again.

In this year's evaluation, EVA Air excelled in the 'Organizational Team' indicator, achieving the highest score. This reflects the high level of recognition and affirmation from employees regarding the company's team collaboration atmosphere, organizational cohesion, and overall work environment.

EVA Air views its employees as its most valuable assets and provides competitive salaries, as well as a range of benefits, including preferential air tickets and employee stock ownership plans. This year, the company has continued to focus on 'work-life balance' and has organized employee day Open House series and health and stress relief days, inviting employees and their families to visit the EVA Air park and maintenance factory to promote family relationships and care for employees' physical and mental health and quality of life.

At the same time, EVA Air has been cultivating talent through job function training courses, encouraging employees to unleash their professional potential, and establishing an open and inclusive workplace culture through various communication mechanisms and ESG talent sustainability strategies.
As the new 787 aircraft fleet is set to join operations, EVA Air is continuing to push forward with its human resource recruitment plan, laying the groundwork for the talent needed in the future.

items.title: 記憶體頂部提前？三星、SK海力士遭多家券商下調目標價 價差最多達200萬韓元
items.title_en: Memory Top Seen Ahead of Schedule? Samsung, SK Hynix Downgraded by Multiple Brokerages
paras: 南韓記憶體雙雄三星電子與SK海力士近期遭多家本土券商下修目標價，市場對「記憶體晶片週期是否已過頂」判斷出現明顯分歧。
未來證券以「週期頂峰可能早於預期」為由，將三星股價目標價從39萬韓元砍至35萬，未來資產證券亦從55萬降至37萬，信韓投資從59萬降至45萬，三星證券從50萬降至40萬，唯獨KB證券堅持「供給短缺至少再持續3年」，維持60萬韓元目標價不動。
市場對SK海力士的分歧則更劇烈。未來資產7月29日將目標價從420萬韓元大砍至280萬，信韓投資由420萬降至270萬，NH投資從410萬降至340萬，大信從390萬降至320萬，三星證券從350萬降至300萬，但韓國投資證券逆勢從380萬上調至470萬韓元。目前各家對SK海力士目標價最低270萬、最高470萬，落差達200萬韓元。
空方邏輯集中在通用DRAM/NAND價格居高位、手機與PC採購轉保守，加上2027年原廠擴產釋放供給，擔憂景氣提前見頂。
市場多方則押注AI伺服器與HBM長協(LTA)訂單鎖住需求，供給端受良率與產能爬坡限制，短缺格局短期難解。即便目標價下修，多數券商仍保留「買入」評級，顯示下修的是估值乘數，而非否認AI記憶體中長線成長性。
這波調整自7月底SK海力士財報後加速，反映資本市場正從「漲價週期」框架切換到「AI資本開支可持續性」框架，短期目標價亂流不改產業核心變數，HBM出貨節奏與2027年供給實際落地速度，才是決定三星、海力士下一波段估值的關鍵。
paras_en: South Korean memory duopoly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have recently been downgraded by multiple local brokerages, with the market showing a clear divergence in judgment on whether the memory chip cycle has peaked.

Future Securities downgraded Samsung's target price to 3.5 million won from 3.9 million, citing 'peak cycle may come earlier than expected.' Future Asset Securities also downgraded it to 3.7 million from 5.5 million, Shinhan Investment to 4.5 million from 5.9 million, Samsung Securities to 4 million from 5 million, while KB Securities maintained its 6 million won target price, citing 'supply shortage to last at least 3 years'.

The divergence in judgment on SK Hynix is even more pronounced. Future Asset Securities downgraded its target price to 2.8 million won from 4.2 million on July 29, Shinhan Investment to 2.7 million from 4.2 million, NH Investment to 3.4 million from 4.1 million, Daesung to 3.2 million from 3.9 million, Samsung Securities to 3 million from 3.5 million, but Korea Investment Securities upgraded it to 4.7 million from 3.8 million. The current target prices for SK Hynix range from 2.7 million to 4.7 million, with a difference of 2 million won.
The bearish logic centers around high prices for DRAM/NAND, conservative smartphone and PC purchases, and the release of supply in 2027, with concerns about the economy peaking ahead of schedule.

The market, on the other hand, is betting on AI server and HBM long-term orders locking in demand, with supply-side constraints from yield rates and production capacity, making it difficult to resolve the shortage in the short term. Despite the downgrades, most brokerages still maintain a 'buy' rating, indicating that the downgrades are a matter of valuation multiples rather than denying the long-term growth potential of AI memory.

This round of adjustments has accelerated since the end of July, reflecting the capital market's shift from the 'rising price cycle' framework to the 'sustainability of AI capital expenditure' framework. The short-term target price fluctuations do not change the core variables of the industry, and the HBM shipment rhythm and the actual supply landing speed in 2027 are the key to determining the next round of valuation for Samsung and SK Hynix.

items.title: 輝達5000億AI融資計劃藏隱憂？川普顧問示警「暗GPU」：AI算力過剩恐引爆投資危機
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正試圖與大型投資機構合作，將GPU從單純的硬體設備轉化為可融資、可產生收益的資產，以協助人工智慧（AI）基礎設施業者解決龐大的資本支出需求。不過，這項計畫也面臨來自川普政府圈內的風險警告。
美國總統川普科學與技術顧問委員會成員David Sacks近日在《All In Podcast》節目中指出，AI算力市場目前真正值得擔心的並不是需求不足，而是供給擴張過快。
他指出，一旦市場出現大量閒置GPU，也就是所謂的「暗GPU」（dark GPU），可能對整個AI基礎設施投資鏈造成重大衝擊。
Sacks以網路泡沫時期的「暗光纖」（dark fiber）作為類比。2000年代初，電信業者曾大舉鋪設光纖，但實際需求遠低於預期，導致大量光纖閒置，價格隨後崩跌。
Sacks認為，若AI資料中心建設速度超過實際算力需求，GPU市場可能重演類似情況。
他表示：「對我來說，最大的風險不在需求側，最大的風險是算力出現過剩、出現過度建設。」
Sacks警告，如果最終形成「暗GPU」，將對所有相關業者造成嚴重衝擊，尤其是那些在建設算力基礎設施時，以每瓦30至50美元現貨價格作為預期的業者。
這項價格估算與馬斯克此前對AI算力價值的說法有關。據報導，馬斯克曾在SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部電話會議中表示，AI算力價值約為每瓦30至50美元，並據此估算，如果能提供1GW算力，到2027年底可能帶來3,000億至5,000億美元營收。
然而，算力基礎設施業者Nebius隨後披露，其多年期雲端服務協議的年合約價值約為每MW 2,000萬至2,500萬美元。
換句話說，馬斯克所估算的價格可能反映短期協議中的溢價水準，而非整個產業的普遍定價。

資料中心建設阻力反而降低供給過剩風險

值得注意的是，Sacks雖然警告AI算力過剩可能造成市場崩潰，但他認為，目前資料中心擴建面臨的政治阻力，反而可能成為防止供給過剩的一道「保險」。
Sacks指出，如果大量業者同時搶進算力供應，最終造成供給過剩，市場就可能面臨崩潰。但目前資料中心建設本身就相當困難，加上各種政治阻力，使算力供給難以快速擴張。
他表示，正是這些阻力，可能讓AI算力供給相對於快速成長的需求維持在較低水準。換言之，資料中心建設的門檻越高，供給就越難在短時間內大幅增加，反而有助於降低「暗GPU」出現的可能性。

AI資本支出龐大　輝達尋求打通融資管道

Sacks同時說明輝達推動GPU金融化的原因。他認為，AI基礎設施業者目前面臨的資本支出規模，已經超出單靠股權與傳統債務融資可以輕易負擔的程度。
Sacks以馬斯克的擴張計畫為例指出，馬斯克預計明年新增約6至8GW算力，相關資本支出可能達3,000億至4,000億美元，而其公司近期透過股權與債務融資籌得約1,000億美元，仍存在龐大的資金缺口。
在這種情況下，Sacks認為，向GPU供應商取得「賣方融資」可能成為其中一種解決方案。
他指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳目前正建立一套信用額度，並透過大型銀行與私募股權機構，向下游買家提供融資管道。
這項計畫的核心概念，是讓GPU不再只是需要大量前期資本支出的硬體，而是轉變為具有金融屬性的資產。透過輝達提供殘值支持，GPU可以被納入融資架構，讓持有者得以利用其未來產生收益的能力取得資金。

items.title: 曾遭興登堡做空、安永辭任審計　美超微走過爭議後AI需求再創新高
items.title_en: Super Micro Computer Bounces Back After Hindenburg Research Short Attack and EY Resignation
paras: 美超微（Super Micro Computer）最新公布2026年第4季財報，單季淨營收達111億美元，相較去年同期翻倍，毛利率升至17.5%，單季新訂單更突破600億美元，並預估2027年營收可達650億至720億美元，顯示AI需求持續強勁。財報公布後，股價於三個交易日內飆升25%。相較於過去一年市場對其公司治理、財務透明度及出口管制等問題的疑慮，如今美超微營運表現重新受到市場關注。
回顧美超微近年的發展，2024年曾是公司面臨高度市場質疑的一年。知名放空機構興登堡研究公司（Hindenburg Research）於2024年8月發布針對美超微的做空報告，提出會計、關係人交易及出口管制等方面的疑慮，報告發布後兩個交易日內，美超微股價累計下跌逾20%，公司財務可信度與治理風險受到嚴格的檢視，進一步加深市場對公司財務與治理狀況的關注。
同年10月，美超微另一項重大考驗接踵而至。公司向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的文件顯示，安永（Ernst & Young，EY）辭任公司註冊會計師，並曾向審計委員會表達對公司治理、透明度及財務報導內部控制等事項的疑慮。消息公布當日，美超微股價重挫近33%，約三分之一市值在一天內蒸發，讓美超微的財務透明度受更大的信任壓力。

不過，事件後續發展並未如市場疑慮所預期。美超微成立獨立特別委員會進行調查，並於2024年12月公布結果，指出調查並未發現管理階層或董事會存在重大不當行為，且特別委員會認為，安永辭任時對內部提出的相關質疑並未成立。走過這段治理與財務透明度風波後，美超微的核心業務仍搭上AI基礎建設快速擴張的浪潮。最新財報顯示，公司第4季營收較去年同期大幅成長，毛利率17.5%也高於先前預估的15%至17%；公司同時表示，過去一年新增數百家企業客戶，單季新訂單超過600億美元，創下歷史新高。值得注意的是，美超微對2027年的營收展望達650億至720億美元，明顯高於市場原先預期，顯示公司對AI伺服器的市場需求仍保持高度信心。
從2024年遭興登堡做空受質疑（興登堡其後於2025年1月宣告解散）、到安永辭任審計，到如今AI伺服器訂單持續攀升、毛利率改善及營收展望上修，美超微受惠於生成式AI帶動相關產業的投資持續擴大，AI伺服器與資料中心基礎設施需求也持續成長。
更值得關注的是，美超微的成長動能已從AI伺服器延伸至大型資料中心、整櫃式系統及液冷AI基礎設施，與輝達（NVIDIA）的合作也持續深化，從Blackwell進一步延伸至新一代Vera Rubin平台，並擴大整合GPU、儲存、網路與軟體的AI資料中心解決方案。
市場接下來關注的焦點，也將從過去的爭議，逐步回到美超微能否將龐大的AI伺服器、大型資料中心訂單轉化為持續性的營收與獲利成長。若訂單能如期轉為出貨，並延續在新一代AI平台、液冷技術與資料中心整體解決方案上的布局，美超微有望從這一輪AI硬體建置浪潮的受惠者，進一步鞏固其在全球AI基礎設施供應鏈中的關鍵位置。
paras_en: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) reported a net revenue of $11.1 billion for the fourth quarter of 2026, more than doubling from the same period last year, with a gross margin of 17.5%. The company also announced that it has secured new orders worth over $6 billion in the quarter and expects revenue to reach $6.5 billion to $7.2 billion in 2027, indicating strong demand for AI.

The company's recent performance has drawn attention from the market, which had previously raised concerns about its corporate governance, financial transparency, and export control issues. In contrast to the past year, when the market was skeptical about Super Micro's governance and financial transparency, the company's current performance has reassured investors.

In 2024, Super Micro faced intense market scrutiny after Hindenburg Research published a short report on the company, raising concerns about accounting, related-party transactions, and export control issues. The report led to a 20% decline in Super Micro's stock price over two trading days, further increasing concerns about the company's financial transparency and governance.

Later that year, in October, Super Micro faced another significant challenge when Ernst & Young (EY) resigned as the company's auditor, citing concerns about corporate governance, transparency, and internal controls. The news led to a 33% decline in Super Micro's stock price, with a third of its market value evaporating in a single day.

However, the subsequent developments did not meet market expectations. Super Micro established an independent special committee to investigate the matter and released its findings in December 2024, which found no significant wrongdoing by management or the board of directors. The committee also concluded that EY's concerns about internal controls were unfounded.

After navigating the governance and financial transparency storm, Super Micro's core business has ridden the wave of rapid expansion in AI infrastructure. The company's latest financial report shows a significant increase in revenue and gross margin, with new orders exceeding $6 billion in the quarter and a record high. Super Micro also announced that it has added hundreds of new enterprise customers in the past year.

Notably, Super Micro's revenue guidance for 2027 is $6.5 billion to $7.2 billion, significantly higher than market expectations, indicating the company's confidence in AI server demand. The company's growth momentum has been driven by the expansion of AI infrastructure, with Super Micro benefiting from the increasing investment in the industry.

paras: 今年以來台灣加權指數大漲近六成，美股S&P500指數同步走揚逾13%，隨著台美股市雙雙進入高檔高原期、波動加劇，選股難度顯著提升，資金紛紛轉向優質ETF。觀察今年股東人數增加最多的前五檔ETF，發現人氣與績效呈高度正相關；其中，統一旗下兩檔00981A、00988A雙雙強勢入榜。

根據CMoney統計至8/14最新數據，人氣榜前五名績效均相當亮眼。第一名由老牌國民ETF元大台灣50(0050-TW)奪下，股東人數增加150.51萬人，今年以來績效達62.2%；第二名則由主動式統一台股增長(00981A-TW)奪得，股東人數增加77.34萬人，今年以來績效高達78.71%。其餘依序為主動式復華未來50(00991A-TW)、富邦科技(0052-TW)及主動式統一全球創新(00988A-TW)。

paras_en: Taiwan's weighted index has surged by nearly 60% this year, while the S&P 500 index in the US has risen by over 13%. As both markets enter the high plateau period, volatility has increased, making stock selection more challenging. As a result, capital has flowed into high-quality ETFs. Observing the top 5 ETFs with the largest increase in shareholder numbers this year, we found a high positive correlation between popularity and performance. The first place is taken by the old national ETF, Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050-TW), with a 62.2% return this year and an increase of 1.5051 million shareholders. The two ETFs under Uni-President, 00981A and 00988A, have both entered the top 5, demonstrating the professional stock-picking skills of the fund managers. As the Taiwan and US markets enter the high plateau period, stock selection becomes more challenging, and market capital is more sensitive to returns. "Performance" has become a key factor in attracting capital flows.

Looking ahead, the research team at Uni-President Investment Trust pointed out that the decrease in June CPI and July employment rates has reduced the urgency of the Fed's short-term interest rate hike, and the strong earnings performance of companies has provided a fundamental support for the market. items.title: 群益：AI電力管理 聚焦二大第三代半導體材料
items.title_en: Goon Yuen: AI Power Management Focuses on Two Big Third-Generation Semiconductor Materials
paras: 群益金鼎證券舉辦「決戰AI投資新賽道論壇」時指出，隨著全球雲端巨頭持續擴大資本支出，AI伺服器帶動資料中心用電需求快速攀升，市場焦點轉向高效率電源管理、高密度供電架構，以及碳化矽(SiC)、氮化鎵(GaN)等第三代半導體材料。
群益投顧表示，全球功率半導體產業的結構性轉型，群益投顧資深研究員黃鵬睿指出，傳統矽基元件已難以滿足高頻、高壓與高溫要求，促使碳化矽(SiC)與氮化鎵(GaN)等寬能隙(WBG)材料進入爆發成長期，此轉型由電動車800V高壓平台和AI資料中心對能源密度的極致需求所驅動，預期SiC和GaN市場將以24-26%年複合成長率成長。
群益投顧進一步分析，AI 伺服器運算導致功耗急遽上升，推動資料中心導入48V直接供電架構，引爆GaN元件與高密度電源轉換模組的強烈需求；在SiC技術上，關鍵在於過渡至8吋晶圓以降低成本；GaN則憑藉高切換頻率，可大幅縮減被動元件體積達40%。
群益投顧預估產業格局將呈兩極化發展，掌握專利電源架構或IDM規模優勢的企業將享有高毛利，反之純技術廠則面臨折舊與低階產能過剩的價格戰考驗，建議投資人布局應緊扣「技術壁壘」和「規模經濟」兩大核心法則。
paras_en: Goon Yuen Securities, which hosted the 'Battle for AI Investment New Track Forum', pointed out that as global cloud giants continue to expand their capital expenditures, AI servers drive the rapid increase in data center electricity demand, and the market focuses on high-efficiency power management, high-density power supply structures, and third-generation semiconductor materials such as silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN).

Goon Yuen Investment pointed out that the structural transformation of the global power semiconductor industry, Goon Yuen Investment's senior research director, Huang Pengrui, said that traditional silicon-based components can no longer meet the requirements of high frequency, high pressure, and high temperature, prompting silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) wide bandgap (WBG) materials to enter a period of explosive growth, driven by the extreme demand for energy density of electric vehicles 800V high-pressure platforms and AI data centers, and it is expected that the SiC and GaN markets will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 24-26%.

Goon Yuen Investment further analyzed that AI server computing leads to a sudden increase in power consumption, driving data centers to introduce 48V direct power supply structures, triggering a strong demand for GaN components and high-density power conversion modules; in terms of SiC technology, the key is to transition to 8-inch wafers to reduce costs; GaN relies on high switching frequencies to significantly reduce passive component volumes by 40%.

Goon Yuen Investment predicts that the industry will develop in a polarized manner, and companies that grasp patented power architectures or IDM scale advantages will enjoy high margins, while pure technology manufacturers will face the challenges of depreciation and low-tier overcapacity in the price war, suggesting that investors should layout according to the two core principles of 'technological barriers' and 'scale economics'.

items.title: 〈房產〉六都預售屋市場結構重組 台北價量齊躍升 高雄交易量慘減半
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Six Metropolitan Areas Restructure Pre-sale Housing Market: Taipei Prices and Volume Surge, Kaohsiung Volume Halved
paras: 全台房市仍冰冷，但由房仲業者統計顯示，2026年1-6月的全台六都預售案交易案件，唯有台北市平交易量年增4.2%，交易價格上漲高達7%。而交易量萎縮最為嚴重的高雄，交易件數則呈現腰斬，下滑高達50.2%

中信房屋研展室彙整實價登錄資料，對比六都2025年上半年與2026年上半年預售屋市場表現，台北市平均房價上漲7%、交易量增加4.2%，新北市平均房價上漲4.4%、交易量減少5.5%，桃園市平均房價上漲2.4%、交易量減少21.6%，台中市平均房價上漲1.5、交易量減少24.9%，台南市平均房價上漲3.1%、交易量減少23.6%，高雄市平均房價上漲1.9%、交易量減少50.2%，整體而言，六都預售房價仍維持上行趨勢，成交量卻普遍下滑，僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的局面。
中信房屋研展室副理莊思敏指出，從六都數據來看，當前預售市場已從過去的熱絡行情，逐步轉向「價格有撐、交易量收斂」的格局。房價方面，在土地成本、營造成本仍處於高檔的情況下，建商讓利空間相對有限，因此價格並未出現修正。然而，在交易量方面，受到信用管制與房貸資金環境影響，市場觀望氣氛瀰漫，買方心態轉趨保守，購屋決策時間也相應拉長，進而使得市場成交動能受到壓抑，交易量同步走弱。
莊思敏示，六都中僅台北市仍呈現「價量俱增」的態勢，主要是因為台北市寸土寸金、土地供給有限、新屋供不應求，加上住宅市場客群多元，除了自住需求之外，也有一定比例的資產配置及長期置產需求，因此即使整體市況降溫，台北市仍能展現相對穩健的韌性。
相較之下，桃園、台中、台南及高雄等地的預售屋交易量則出現了較為明顯的量縮，以上區域的新建案多集中於新興重劃區或蛋白區，雖具備重大建設、交通項目或產業進駐等長期利多，惟部分區塊的生活機能仍處於起步階段，而房價卻已超前反映未來願景，如今隨著市場回歸剛性需求，買方出手更加謹慎，追價意願大幅降低，交易量自然隨之縮減。
莊思敏表示，目前房市仍處於盤整期，建議消費者應保持理性，審慎評估自身需求和財務狀況，避免盲目追價。此外，由於交易量持續走低、建商資金周轉壓力加重，市面上偶有建商財務危機或工程延宕的消息出現，消費者在挑選預售案時，務必要多加留意建商口碑與履約能力，以降低交易風險。
paras_en: The nationwide housing market remains cold, but data from real‑estate agents shows that for pre‑sale projects in the six major cities during the first half of 2026, only Taipei City recorded a 4.2% year‑over‑year increase in transaction volume and a price jump of up to 7%. In Kaohsiung, where the decline was most severe, the number of transactions was cut in half, dropping 50.2%.

The research department of CTBC Real Estate compiled official transaction‑price data and compared the pre‑sale market performance of the six cities between the first half of 2025 and the first half of 2026. Taipei’s average price rose 7% with a 4.2% rise in volume; New Taipei’s average price rose 4.4% while volume fell 5.5%; Taoyuan’s average price rose 2.4% with volume down 21.6%; Taichung’s average price rose 1.5% with volume down 24.9%; Tainan’s average price rose 3.1% with volume down 23.6%; Kaohsiung’s average price rose 1.9% with volume down 50.2%. Overall, pre‑sale prices in the six cities kept climbing, but transaction volumes generally fell, with only Taipei showing a “price‑and‑volume increase” scenario.

Zhuang Simin, deputy manager of CTBC Real Estate’s research department, said that the data from the six cities indicate the pre‑sale market has shifted from a previously hot climate to a pattern of “prices holding up while transaction volume contracts.” With land and construction costs still high, developers have limited room to cut prices, so prices have not been corrected. However, transaction volume is being squeezed by credit controls and the mortgage funding environment, creating a pervasive wait‑and‑see mood. Buyers are becoming more conservative and taking longer to decide, which dampens market momentum and weakens volume.

Zhuang noted that only Taipei still shows a “price‑and‑volume increase” because the city’s land is extremely scarce, supply of new homes cannot meet demand, and the residential market serves a diverse clientele. Besides owner‑occupiers, there is a sizable segment of investors and long‑term property‑placement demand, so even as overall conditions cool, Taipei can still demonstrate relatively robust resilience.

In contrast, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung have seen a more pronounced contraction in pre‑sale transaction volume. New projects in these areas are largely concentrated in emerging redevelopment zones or “egg‑white” districts that, while promising major infrastructure, transport projects or industry entry in the long run, still have nascent living‑amenity infrastructure. Prices have already priced in future expectations, and as the market returns to rigid demand, buyers are far more cautious, their willingness to chase prices has dropped sharply, and transaction volume has naturally shrunk.

Zhuang said the housing market remains in a consolidation phase and advised consumers to stay rational, carefully assess their own needs and financial situation, and avoid blindly chasing prices. Moreover, as transaction volumes continue to fall and developers face tighter cash flow, occasional news of developer financial distress or project delays emerges. Buyers should therefore pay close attention to a developer’s reputation and ability to fulfill contracts when selecting pre‑sale projects, to reduce transaction risk.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉資本利得配息占比逾9成 00881、00878除息前夕爆大量
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Capital Gains Distribution Ratio Exceeds 90% for 00881 and 00878 Before Dividend Payment
paras: 科技大廠財報與營運數據陸續報喜，帶動市場資金持續湧入台股。國泰投信旗下 2 檔高人氣 ETF—國泰台灣科技龍頭(00881-TW)與國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)即將於明(18)日正式除息，今(17)日為參與本次收益分配的最後買進日，由於 2 檔資本利得配息占比均突破 9 成，吸引買盤強勢卡位，00881 盤中成交量衝破 5 萬張，00878 更爆出逾 8.6 萬張大量，雙雙展現強勁交投氣勢。
據國泰投信公告，00881 本次每單位預計配發 4.6 元，00878 每單位則配發 1.01 元。受高額配息與 AI 題材激勵，兩檔 ETF 人氣同步飆升，自 7 月底公告預估配息以來，00881 單周受益人數增加約 1.5 萬人，00878 受益人數亦大增逾 1.1 萬人，顯示市場關注度持續居高不下。
針對市場關注的「收益分配來源」，00881 基金經理人蘇鼎宇表示，根據官方公布之組成占比，00881 本次配息中，已實現資本利得高達 98.91%，股利所得僅占 1.09%；而 00878 基金經理人江宇騰亦指出，00878 本次資本利得占比同樣高達 90.10%，股利所得占 9.90%。
蘇鼎宇分析，配息主要來自基金投資部位累積並實現的資本利得，充分反映近年台灣科技龍頭股價成長的成果。依現行稅制，個人投資人取得之已實現資本利得免納所得稅，且不計入二代健保補充保費。兩檔 ETF 配息結構皆有逾 9 成來自資本利得，成為吸引投資人青睞的一大稅務亮點(實際課稅仍依投資人個別身分及相關法令規定為準)。
在基本面表現上，蘇鼎宇進一步指出，近期科技龍頭營運成績為 AI 產業提供強烈支撐。台積電 7 月營收再創單月新高；鴻海公布第二季財報，單季營收達新台幣 2.53 兆元，稅後淨利約 600 億元、年增 35%，營收與獲利均創歷年同期新高，展現 AI 伺服器的強勁需求。
隨著全球 AI 投資從資本支出擴張進入「獲利驗證」階段，市場焦點已轉向企業能否將需求轉化為實質營收。台灣科技供應鏈憑藉完整的產業聚落與技術優勢，長線仍將是全球 AI 發展趨勢下的最大受惠者。

paras_en: The technology giant's financial reports and operating data have been released one after another, driving continuous capital inflows into the Taiwan Stock Exchange. Two popular ETFs under Cathay Securities Investment Trust, Cathay Taiwan Tech Leaders (00881-TW) and Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878-TW), are scheduled to officially pay dividends on August 18. items.title: 國籍航空唯一 華航連4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎
items.title_en: EVA Air Wins Asia's Best Employer for 4th Consecutive Year
paras: 2026 年亞洲最佳企業雇主獎(HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia)評比結果出爐，華航(2610-TW)再度脫穎而出，蟬聯四屆「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」殊榮，為唯一連續獲獎的國籍航空。
「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」是亞洲人力資源領域最具指標性的年度評選之一，也為衡量企業雇主品牌的重要標竿，今年台灣區共有 330 家企業參選，華航於激烈評選中再創佳績，連續四年抱回「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」。
此次評選中，華航於「組織團隊」指標表現尤為亮眼，獲得最高分數，充分反映員工對公司團隊合作氛圍、組織凝聚力和整體工作環境的高度認同及肯定。
華航表示，視員工為公司最重要的資產，提供具市場競爭力的薪資，以及優待機票、員工持股信託等多元福利制度，今年持續以「工作生活平衡」為核心，舉辦員工日 Open House 系列活動及健康紓壓日，邀請同仁與眷屬參訪華航園區及修護工廠，促進親子關係，照顧員工身心健康與生活品質。
同時，華航深耕人才培育，規劃職能訓練課程，鼓勵員工發揮專業潛能，並透過多方溝通機制及 ESG 人才永續策略，建立開放共融的職場文化。
隨著全新 787 機隊即將加入營運，華航正持續推動人力招募計畫，提前布局未來所需人才。
paras_en: EVA Air (2610-TW) has emerged as the winner of the 2026 Asia's Best Employer award (HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia) for the fourth consecutive year, making it the only national carrier to achieve this feat.

The Asia's Best Employer award is one of the most prestigious annual awards in the human resources field in Asia, and serves as an important benchmark for measuring a company's employer brand. This year, a total of 330 companies in Taiwan participated in the competition, with EVA Air emerging victorious once again.

In this year's evaluation, EVA Air excelled in the 'Organizational Team' indicator, achieving the highest score. This reflects the high level of recognition and affirmation from employees regarding the company's team collaboration atmosphere, organizational cohesion, and overall work environment.

EVA Air views its employees as its most valuable assets and provides competitive salaries, as well as a range of benefits, including preferential air tickets and employee stock ownership plans. This year, the company has continued to focus on 'work-life balance' and has organized employee day Open House series and health and stress relief days, inviting employees and their families to visit the EVA Air park and maintenance factory to promote family relationships and care for employees' physical and mental health and quality of life.

At the same time, EVA Air has been cultivating talent through job function training courses, encouraging employees to unleash their professional potential, and establishing an open and inclusive workplace culture through various communication mechanisms and ESG talent sustainability strategies.
As the new 787 aircraft fleet is set to join operations, EVA Air is continuing to push forward with its human resource recruitment plan, laying the groundwork for the talent needed in the future.

items.title: 曾遭興登堡做空、安永辭任審計　美超微走過爭議後AI需求再創新高
items.title_en: Super Micro Computer Bounces Back After Hindenburg Research Short Attack and EY Resignation
paras: 美超微（Super Micro Computer）最新公布2026年第4季財報，單季淨營收達111億美元，相較去年同期翻倍，毛利率升至17.5%，單季新訂單更突破600億美元，並預估2027年營收可達650億至720億美元，顯示AI需求持續強勁。財報公布後，股價於三個交易日內飆升25%。相較於過去一年市場對其公司治理、財務透明度及出口管制等問題的疑慮，如今美超微營運表現重新受到市場關注。
回顧美超微近年的發展，2024年曾是公司面臨高度市場質疑的一年。知名放空機構興登堡研究公司（Hindenburg Research）於2024年8月發布針對美超微的做空報告，提出會計、關係人交易及出口管制等方面的疑慮，報告發布後兩個交易日內，美超微股價累計下跌逾20%，公司財務可信度與治理風險受到嚴格的檢視，進一步加深市場對公司財務與治理狀況的關注。
同年10月，美超微另一項重大考驗接踵而至。公司向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的文件顯示，安永（Ernst & Young，EY）辭任公司註冊會計師，並曾向審計委員會表達對公司治理、透明度及財務報導內部控制等事項的疑慮。消息公布當日，美超微股價重挫近33%，約三分之一市值在一天內蒸發，讓美超微的財務透明度受更大的信任壓力。

不過，事件後續發展並未如市場疑慮所預期。美超微成立獨立特別委員會進行調查，並於2024年12月公布結果，指出調查並未發現管理階層或董事會存在重大不當行為，且特別委員會認為，安永辭任時對內部提出的相關質疑並未成立。走過這段治理與財務透明度風波後，美超微的核心業務仍搭上AI基礎建設快速擴張的浪潮。最新財報顯示，公司第4季營收較去年同期大幅成長，毛利率17.5%也高於先前預估的15%至17%；公司同時表示，過去一年新增數百家企業客戶，單季新訂單超過600億美元，創下歷史新高。值得注意的是，美超微對2027年的營收展望達650億至720億美元，明顯高於市場原先預期，顯示公司對AI伺服器的市場需求仍保持高度信心。
從2024年遭興登堡做空受質疑（興登堡其後於2025年1月宣告解散）、到安永辭任審計，到如今AI伺服器訂單持續攀升、毛利率改善及營收展望上修，美超微受惠於生成式AI帶動相關產業的投資持續擴大，AI伺服器與資料中心基礎設施需求也持續成長。
更值得關注的是，美超微的成長動能已從AI伺服器延伸至大型資料中心、整櫃式系統及液冷AI基礎設施，與輝達（NVIDIA）的合作也持續深化，從Blackwell進一步延伸至新一代Vera Rubin平台，並擴大整合GPU、儲存、網路與軟體的AI資料中心解決方案。
市場接下來關注的焦點，也將從過去的爭議，逐步回到美超微能否將龐大的AI伺服器、大型資料中心訂單轉化為持續性的營收與獲利成長。若訂單能如期轉為出貨，並延續在新一代AI平台、液冷技術與資料中心整體解決方案上的布局，美超微有望從這一輪AI硬體建置浪潮的受惠者，進一步鞏固其在全球AI基礎設施供應鏈中的關鍵位置。
paras_en: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) reported a net revenue of $11.1 billion for the fourth quarter of 2026, more than doubling from the same period last year, with a gross margin of 17.5%. The company also announced that it has secured new orders worth over $6 billion in the quarter and expects revenue to reach $6.5 billion to $7.2 billion in 2027, indicating strong demand for AI.

The company's recent performance has drawn attention from the market, which had previously raised concerns about its corporate governance, financial transparency, and export control issues. In contrast to the past year, when the market was skeptical about Super Micro's governance and financial transparency, the company's current performance has reassured investors.

In 2024, Super Micro faced intense market scrutiny after Hindenburg Research published a short report on the company, raising concerns about accounting, related-party transactions, and export control issues. The report led to a 20% decline in Super Micro's stock price over two trading days, further increasing concerns about the company's financial transparency and governance.

Later that year, in October, Super Micro faced another significant challenge when Ernst & Young (EY) resigned as the company's auditor, citing concerns about corporate governance, transparency, and internal controls. The news led to a 33% decline in Super Micro's stock price, with a third of its market value evaporating in a single day.

However, the subsequent developments did not meet market expectations. Super Micro established an independent special committee to investigate the matter and released its findings in December 2024, which found no significant wrongdoing by management or the board of directors. The committee also concluded that EY's concerns about internal controls were unfounded.

After navigating the governance and financial transparency storm, Super Micro's core business has ridden the wave of rapid expansion in AI infrastructure. The company's latest financial report shows a significant increase in revenue and gross margin, with new orders exceeding $6 billion in the quarter and a record high. Super Micro also announced that it has added hundreds of new enterprise customers in the past year.

Notably, Super Micro's revenue guidance for 2027 is $6.5 billion to $7.2 billion, significantly higher than market expectations, indicating the company's confidence in AI server demand. The company's growth momentum has been driven by the expansion of AI infrastructure, with Super Micro benefiting from the increasing investment in the industry.
