items.title: 群益：AI電力管理 聚焦二大第三代半導體材料
items.title_en: Goon Yuen: AI Power Management Focuses on Two Big Third-Generation Semiconductor Materials
paras: 群益金鼎證券舉辦「決戰AI投資新賽道論壇」時指出，隨著全球雲端巨頭持續擴大資本支出，AI伺服器帶動資料中心用電需求快速攀升，市場焦點轉向高效率電源管理、高密度供電架構，以及碳化矽(SiC)、氮化鎵(GaN)等第三代半導體材料。
群益投顧表示，全球功率半導體產業的結構性轉型，群益投顧資深研究員黃鵬睿指出，傳統矽基元件已難以滿足高頻、高壓與高溫要求，促使碳化矽(SiC)與氮化鎵(GaN)等寬能隙(WBG)材料進入爆發成長期，此轉型由電動車800V高壓平台和AI資料中心對能源密度的極致需求所驅動，預期SiC和GaN市場將以24-26%年複合成長率成長。
群益投顧進一步分析，AI 伺服器運算導致功耗急遽上升，推動資料中心導入48V直接供電架構，引爆GaN元件與高密度電源轉換模組的強烈需求；在SiC技術上，關鍵在於過渡至8吋晶圓以降低成本；GaN則憑藉高切換頻率，可大幅縮減被動元件體積達40%。
群益投顧預估產業格局將呈兩極化發展，掌握專利電源架構或IDM規模優勢的企業將享有高毛利，反之純技術廠則面臨折舊與低階產能過剩的價格戰考驗，建議投資人布局應緊扣「技術壁壘」和「規模經濟」兩大核心法則。
paras_en: Goon Yuen Securities, which hosted the 'Battle for AI Investment New Track Forum', pointed out that as global cloud giants continue to expand their capital expenditures, AI servers drive the rapid increase in data center electricity demand, and the market focuses on high-efficiency power management, high-density power supply structures, and third-generation semiconductor materials such as silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN).

Goon Yuen Investment pointed out that the structural transformation of the global power semiconductor industry, Goon Yuen Investment's senior research director, Huang Pengrui, said that traditional silicon-based components can no longer meet the requirements of high frequency, high pressure, and high temperature, prompting silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) wide bandgap (WBG) materials to enter a period of explosive growth, driven by the extreme demand for energy density of electric vehicles 800V high-pressure platforms and AI data centers, and it is expected that the SiC and GaN markets will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 24-26%.

Goon Yuen Investment further analyzed that AI server computing leads to a sudden increase in power consumption, driving data centers to introduce 48V direct power supply structures, triggering a strong demand for GaN components and high-density power conversion modules; in terms of SiC technology, the key is to transition to 8-inch wafers to reduce costs; GaN relies on high switching frequencies to significantly reduce passive component volumes by 40%.

Goon Yuen Investment predicts that the industry will develop in a polarized manner, and companies that grasp patented power architectures or IDM scale advantages will enjoy high margins, while pure technology manufacturers will face the challenges of depreciation and low-tier overcapacity in the price war, suggesting that investors should layout according to the two core principles of 'technological barriers' and 'scale economics'.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉晟德實施2萬張庫藏股自救奏效 止跌一度填權息逾3成
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Sheng De Implements 20,000 Treasury Shares Buyback, Stops Decline Once, Exceeds 3% Dividend Yield
paras: 晟德(4123-TW)上半年受到轉投資事業股價修正影響，拖累上半年虧損達84.81億元，使得晟德近日股價重挫。而晟德公告實施2萬張庫藏股，預定買回最高金額8.4億元，今(17)日股價止跌，早盤最高漲逾3%，一度填權息超過3成。
晟德上半年受到轉投資事業股價修正影響，上半年帳列損失達106億元，拖累上半年虧損達84.81億元，每股虧損11.24元，即便上半年累計淨現金流入達32.9億元，但近日股價表現仍弱勢，上周五(14日)最低跌至31.65元，跌至去年股災低點。
晟德上周五公告實施庫藏股自救，預定買回庫藏股2萬張，買回區間價格為28至42元，若股價低於區間價格下限，將繼續買回，預定買回所需最高金額8.4億元。晟德指出，此次為第四次實施庫藏股，目的為轉讓股份給員工。
晟德今天早盤以31.85元開高，盤中最高漲至32.2元，漲幅超過3%，成交量超過2000張。而晟德今日進行除權息交易，配發每股1.75元現金股利，股票股利0.5元，合計2.25元股利，今天一度填權息超過3成。
paras_en: Sheng De (4123-TW) was affected by the revaluation of its investment business in the first half of the year, resulting in a net loss of NT$ 848.1 billion, causing the company's stock price to plummet in recent days. Sheng De announced the implementation of a 20,000 treasury shares buyback plan, with a maximum purchase amount of NT$ 840 million, and the stock price stopped declining on the 17th, with an early morning high of over 3%, once exceeding 3% dividend yield.

Sheng De's first half of the year was affected by the revaluation of its investment business, with a net loss of NT$ 106 billion, resulting in a net loss of NT$ 848.1 billion. Each share lost NT$ 11.24, even though the company's cumulative net cash flow was NT$ 329 million in the first half of the year, but the stock price still showed weakness last week, with a low of NT$ 31.65 on Friday, the 14th, which was lower than the low point of last year's stock market crash.

Sheng De announced on Friday last week that it would implement a treasury shares buyback plan, with a plan to purchase 20,000 treasury shares, with a price range of NT$ 28 to NT$ 42. If the stock price is lower than the lower limit of the price range, it will continue to purchase, with a maximum purchase amount of NT$ 840 million. Sheng De pointed out that this is the fourth time it has implemented a treasury shares buyback plan, with the purpose of transferring shares to employees.

Sheng De's stock price opened at NT$ 31.85 this morning, with a high of NT$ 32.2 during the day, exceeding 3% in price, with a trading volume of over 2,000 shares. Sheng De conducted a dividend payment today, distributing NT$ 1.75 per share in cash dividends and NT$ 0.5 per share in stock dividends, totaling NT$ 2.25 per share in dividends, and once exceeded 3% dividend yield.

items.title: 東浦布局越泰等新生產基地效益將顯 H2對AI相關產品放量出貨
items.title_en: Dongpu's Layout of New Production Bases in Vietnam and Thailand Shows Benefits; H2 to Ramp Up Shipments of AI-Related Products
paras: 塑膠射出及模具廠東浦精密(3290-TW)在積極布局泰國並併購東南亞越南企業之後，新生產基地效益逐漸顯著並推升單月營收步步走高，7月營收並達3.66億元，公司在AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統的插接箱零組件和架空配電組件也在第三季起放量出貨。
東浦精密在2026年上半年受到人民幣強勢升值影響，匯兌損失約5600萬元，對每股的影響約0.62元。而第二季單季也仍有獲利。
2025年底東浦精密以6.21億收購美商Bi-Link，2026年起納入合併報表，整合塑膠＋金屬產品線，提升附加價值、客戶議價能力、拓展全球客戶版圖，因收購產生一次性的廉價購買利益，第二季追加無形資產，包含專利技術、客戶關係等，最終廉價購買利益約有4.18億元，貢獻每股獲利達4.65元。
東浦精密對2026年下半年的展望指出，由東浦開發的高階電聲產品，客戶經過上半年的新舊產品轉換空窗期，第二季中開始恢復出貨，第三季起將進到傳統旺季，本業恢復成長動能，而Bi-Link的AI產品也於本季大量出貨，用於AI資料中心配電系統（Track Busway）的插接箱（Paddle）零組件和架空配電組件，將帶動整體毛利率逐步回升到過去水準，目標全年營收維持上半年的營收成長動能。
東浦精密日前通過設立泰國子公司，預計投資6億泰銖，為因應國際趨勢，並考量長期產銷發展與產業聚落影響，透過區域化生產布局擴大生產規模、調度產能彈性，強化長期競爭優勢與客戶服務品質。
paras_en: Dongpu Precision (3290‑TW), a plastic injection‑molding and tooling company, has been actively expanding in Thailand and acquiring a Southeast Asian firm in Vietnam. The benefits of the new production bases are becoming evident, driving monthly revenue higher month by month, with July revenue reaching NT$366 million. The company also shipped AI products in large volumes this quarter, and components for AI data‑center power distribution systems—such as junction box parts and overhead distribution modules—are set to be shipped in greater quantities starting in the third quarter.

Dongpu Precision incurred a foreign‑exchange loss of about NT$56 million in 2026 due to the strong appreciation of the Chinese yuan, affecting earnings per share by roughly NT$0.62. Nevertheless, the company remained profitable in the second quarter.

At the end of 2025, Dongpu Precision acquired U.S. company Bi‑Link for NT$621 million and will consolidate it into its financial statements from 2026, integrating plastic and metal product lines to enhance value‑add, bargaining power, and global customer reach. The acquisition generated a one‑time cheap‑purchase benefit; in the second quarter, additional intangible assets such as patents and customer relationships were added, resulting in an overall cheap‑purchase benefit of about NT$418 million, contributing NT$4.65 to earnings per share.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Dongpu notes that its high‑end electro‑acoustic products, developed in‑house, are emerging from a transition gap between old and new products in the first half of the year. Shipments began to recover in the second quarter and will enter the traditional peak season in the third quarter, restoring growth momentum in its core business. Bi‑Link’s AI products are also being shipped in large volumes this quarter, including junction‑box (Paddle) components and overhead distribution modules for AI data‑center power distribution systems (Track Busway), which should gradually lift overall gross margins back to previous levels. The company aims to maintain the revenue growth momentum achieved in the first half throughout the full year.

Dongpu Precision recently established a subsidiary in Thailand, planning to invest THB 600 million. The move responds to international trends and considers long‑term production, sales, and development as well as the impact of industry clusters. By regionalizing production, the company seeks to expand scale, increase capacity flexibility, and strengthen its long‑term competitive advantage and customer service quality.

items.title: 輝達5000億AI融資計劃藏隱憂？川普顧問示警「暗GPU」：AI算力過剩恐引爆投資危機
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正試圖與大型投資機構合作，將GPU從單純的硬體設備轉化為可融資、可產生收益的資產，以協助人工智慧（AI）基礎設施業者解決龐大的資本支出需求。不過，這項計畫也面臨來自川普政府圈內的風險警告。
美國總統川普科學與技術顧問委員會成員David Sacks近日在《All In Podcast》節目中指出，AI算力市場目前真正值得擔心的並不是需求不足，而是供給擴張過快。
他指出，一旦市場出現大量閒置GPU，也就是所謂的「暗GPU」（dark GPU），可能對整個AI基礎設施投資鏈造成重大衝擊。
Sacks以網路泡沫時期的「暗光纖」（dark fiber）作為類比。2000年代初，電信業者曾大舉鋪設光纖，但實際需求遠低於預期，導致大量光纖閒置，價格隨後崩跌。
Sacks認為，若AI資料中心建設速度超過實際算力需求，GPU市場可能重演類似情況。
他表示：「對我來說，最大的風險不在需求側，最大的風險是算力出現過剩、出現過度建設。」
Sacks警告，如果最終形成「暗GPU」，將對所有相關業者造成嚴重衝擊，尤其是那些在建設算力基礎設施時，以每瓦30至50美元現貨價格作為預期的業者。
這項價格估算與馬斯克此前對AI算力價值的說法有關。據報導，馬斯克曾在SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部電話會議中表示，AI算力價值約為每瓦30至50美元，並據此估算，如果能提供1GW算力，到2027年底可能帶來3,000億至5,000億美元營收。
然而，算力基礎設施業者Nebius隨後披露，其多年期雲端服務協議的年合約價值約為每MW 2,000萬至2,500萬美元。
換句話說，馬斯克所估算的價格可能反映短期協議中的溢價水準，而非整個產業的普遍定價。

資料中心建設阻力反而降低供給過剩風險

值得注意的是，Sacks雖然警告AI算力過剩可能造成市場崩潰，但他認為，目前資料中心擴建面臨的政治阻力，反而可能成為防止供給過剩的一道「保險」。
Sacks指出，如果大量業者同時搶進算力供應，最終造成供給過剩，市場就可能面臨崩潰。但目前資料中心建設本身就相當困難，加上各種政治阻力，使算力供給難以快速擴張。
他表示，正是這些阻力，可能讓AI算力供給相對於快速成長的需求維持在較低水準。換言之，資料中心建設的門檻越高，供給就越難在短時間內大幅增加，反而有助於降低「暗GPU」出現的可能性。

AI資本支出龐大　輝達尋求打通融資管道

Sacks同時說明輝達推動GPU金融化的原因。他認為，AI基礎設施業者目前面臨的資本支出規模，已經超出單靠股權與傳統債務融資可以輕易負擔的程度。
Sacks以馬斯克的擴張計畫為例指出，馬斯克預計明年新增約6至8GW算力，相關資本支出可能達3,000億至4,000億美元，而其公司近期透過股權與債務融資籌得約1,000億美元，仍存在龐大的資金缺口。
在這種情況下，Sacks認為，向GPU供應商取得「賣方融資」可能成為其中一種解決方案。
他指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳目前正建立一套信用額度，並透過大型銀行與私募股權機構，向下游買家提供融資管道。
這項計畫的核心概念，是讓GPU不再只是需要大量前期資本支出的硬體，而是轉變為具有金融屬性的資產。透過輝達提供殘值支持，GPU可以被納入融資架構，讓持有者得以利用其未來產生收益的能力取得資金。

items.title: 初期掉電快、後期很耐用！特斯拉Model Y一年跑4萬公里後 電池容量還有91%
items.title_en: Tesla Model Y's Battery Degradation: Initial Drop-Off, Then Long-Term Reliability
paras: 電動車車主最擔心電池「越用越短」，但最新實測數據顯示，電動車電池的衰減其實集中在初期，隨後便會趨於平緩。
根據《Insideevs》報導，美國網紅Andy Slye駕駛2026年式特斯拉Model Y Premium後驅版一年、行駛約4萬公里後，透過第三方服務Recurrent估算，電池健康度仍維持在91%左右，讓他直言「完全不擔心」。
這一發現與電池分析機構Voltest的研究吻合。Voltest指出，採用鎳基電池的長續航特斯拉車款，最明顯的容量衰減多發生前兩到三年或行駛8萬公里內，一旦度過初期階段，約90%的健康度便會成為穩定基準，後續衰減曲線將大幅趨緩。
Recurrent透過分析車輛回傳的電量狀態、預估續航、行駛里程、充電紀錄與溫度等數據，交叉比對同型車款得出結論。Slye平時主要在家中以交流電充電，僅偶爾使用Supercharger超級充電站，且車輛第一年都在氣候溫和的肯塔基州度過，並未長期暴露於會加速電池老化的高溫環境，這代表91%的數據並非來自頻繁快充或酷熱氣候的極端損耗。
Slye曾進行滿電至0%的完整續航測試，以高速公路車速實測跑出483公里，恰好符合預估值。他計算，若日常只充至80%，實際續航約386公里，對通勤與生活已綽綽有餘。他笑稱，自己本來就不喜歡一次開這麼遠。
實際案例也印證上述趨勢：一輛行駛三年的高里程Model 3計程車，電池容量仍保有88.5%，甚至一輛2015年式Model S P85D，在累積近25.7萬公里後，健康度還有約86%。
專家指出，早期衰減不代表未來10萬英里(約16萬公里)表現，電池壽命仍受駕駛習慣、氣候與充電頻率等多重因素影響，但對大多數車主而言，「初期掉電快、後期很耐用」的規律，無疑是一顆定心丸。
paras_en: Electric vehicle owners are often concerned that their car's battery will degrade over time, but recent data suggests that the initial drop-off in battery capacity is concentrated in the early stages, with a subsequent leveling off.

According to a report by Insideevs, American social media influencer Andy Slye drove his 2026 Tesla Model Y Premium rear-wheel drive for a year, covering approximately 40,000 kilometers, and using a third-party service called Recurrent, estimated that the battery health was still around 91%.

This finding is consistent with research by Voltest, a battery analysis company. Voltest notes that Tesla models with nickel-based batteries, which have a long range, experience the most significant capacity degradation within the first two to three years or within the first 80,000 kilometers. Once this initial period is passed, around 90% of the battery health becomes a stable baseline, with subsequent degradation curves becoming much flatter.

Recurrent analyzed the vehicle's returned energy state, estimated range, mileage, charging records, and temperature data to cross-reference with other models of the same type and draw conclusions. Slye typically charges his car at home using alternating current and only occasionally uses Supercharger fast-charging stations, and his car spent its first year in the mild climate of Kentucky, without prolonged exposure to high temperatures that can accelerate battery degradation.

Slye has performed a full-range test from 100% to 0% and achieved a range of 483 kilometers at highway speeds, exactly matching the estimated value. He calculated that if he only charged to 80%, the actual range would be around 386 kilometers, which is more than sufficient for daily commutes and living. He jokingly said that he didn't like driving that far anyway.

Real-world examples also confirm this trend: a three-year-old high-mileage Model 3 taxi car still has a battery capacity of 88.5%, and a 2015 Model S P85D with nearly 257,000 kilometers on the clock still has a battery health of around 86%.

Experts note that early degradation does not necessarily mean poor performance over the next 100,000 miles (approximately 160,000 kilometers), as battery lifespan is influenced by multiple factors, including driving habits, climate, and charging frequency. However, for most owners, the rule of thumb that 'initial drop-off is fast, but long-term reliability is good' is undoubtedly a reassuring one.

items.title: 「光進銅退」時代來了！輝達CPO交換器正式出貨：功耗暴降80%、頻寬衝上409.6Tb/s
items.title_en: The Era of 'Optical Over Copper' Has Arrived! HUAWEI's CPO Interchangeable Module Officially Delivered: Power Consumption Drops 80%, Bandwidth Reaches 409.6Tb/s
paras: 輝達上週五(14日)透過官方社群帳號宣布，全球首款進入量產的200G/lane CPO乙太網路交換器系統「Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics」正式出貨，CoreWeave、Lambda 與甲骨文為首批採用客戶，該產品在今年5-7月進入生產階段，標誌著資料中心網路架構正式邁入「光進銅退」的新紀元。
Spectrum-X基於新一代 Spectrum-6交換晶片打造，採用共封裝光學(CPO)技術，將光學引擎與交換ASIC直接整合於同一模組內，電訊號傳輸路徑從傳統的 15 至 30 公分 PCB 走線縮短至毫米級。
相較於傳統可插拔收發器架構，光損耗從約22dB大幅降至4dB，訊號完整性提升64倍。單顆Spectrum-6晶片交換容量達 102.4Tb/s，為上一代兩倍；旗艦機型SN6800可配置為512個 800Gb/s或2048個200Gb/s埠，總頻寬高達409.6Tb/s，同時雷射數量減少75%、功耗降低80%，平均故障間隔時間提升十倍。
這項技術突破背後，是輝達與全球供應鏈的深度協同：台積電提供先進矽光子製程，矽品負責晶圓級與晶片級封測，Lumentum供應雷射晶片，天孚通信完成模組子組件組裝，鴻海則擔綱整機交換器系統組裝，輝達並在自有設施執行出貨前最終測試，確保產品良率與可靠性。
值得關注的是，輝達近月在CPO領域的投資動作頻頻。今年3月分別向Lumentum與Coherent各投資20億美元，並簽署多年供應協議，5月再跟康寧達成策略合作，透過最高 27 億美元投資在美新建三座先進工廠，短短三個月累計投資至少65億美元，顯示輝達將光互連技術視為下一代AI工廠的核心戰略。
隨著AI算力叢集從萬卡擴張至十萬卡、百萬卡規模，資料中心瓶頸已從單顆GPU算力轉向叢集互聯能力。市場研究機構數據顯示，今年全球CPO市場規模預計達20億美元，年增逾400%，高盛更預測2028年將衝上910億美元。
隨著輝達Vera Rubin平台量產持續推進，矽光互連可望成為標準配備，相關供應鏈景氣度持續看升。
paras_en: HUAWEI announced on Friday last week (14th) through its official social media account that the world's first 200G/lane CPO Ethernet network exchange system, 'Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics', has officially been delivered. CoreWeave, Lambda, and Oracle are the first batch of customers to adopt this product, which entered the production stage in May-July this year, marking the beginning of the era of 'optical over copper' in data center network architecture.

Spectrum-X is based on the new-generation Spectrum-6 exchange chip, using the CPO technology to integrate the optical engine and exchange ASIC directly into the same module. The transmission path of the electrical signal is shortened from the traditional 15-30 cm PCB line to millimeter-level.

Compared to traditional plug-and-play transceiver architectures, the optical loss has been significantly reduced from approximately 22 dB to 4 dB, with signal integrity improved by 64 times. A single Spectrum-6 chip can exchange 102.4Tb/s, which is twice that of the previous generation. The flagship model SN6800 can be configured with 512 800Gb/s or 2048 200Gb/s ports, with a total bandwidth of up to 409.6Tb/s, while reducing laser numbers by 75% and power consumption by 80%, and increasing average time between failures by ten times.

Behind this technology breakthrough is the deep collaboration between HUAWEI and the global supply chain: TSMC provides advanced silicon photonics processes, SilTerra is responsible for wafer-level and chip-level packaging, Lumentum supplies laser chips, and Foxconn completes module component assembly, while HUAWEI assembles the entire exchange system and performs final testing at its own facilities to ensure product yield and reliability.

Notably, HUAWEI has been actively investing in the CPO field in recent months. In March, it invested $2 billion each in Lumentum and Coherent, signing multi-year supply agreements, and in May, it reached a strategic cooperation with Corning, investing up to $2.7 billion to build three advanced factories in the US. In just three months, HUAWEI has invested at least $6.5 billion, demonstrating its vision of optical interconnect technology as a core strategy for the next-generation AI factory.

As AI computing clusters expand from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of cards, data center bottlenecks have shifted from individual GPU performance to cluster interconnect capabilities. Market research data shows that the global CPO market is expected to reach $2 billion this year, with a year-over-year growth of over 400%, and Goldman Sachs predicts that it will reach $9.1 billion in 2028.
With the continuous progress of HUAWEI's Vera Rubin platform, silicon photonics interconnects are expected to become standard equipment, and the supply chain outlook remains optimistic.

items.title: 高盛助攻輝達打造5000億美元融資平台 破解AI基建最大資金瓶頸
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Helps Hicloud Build $50 Billion Financing Platform to Break AI Infrastructure Funding Bottleneck
paras: AI軍備競賽正面臨一個買得起晶片，卻未必扛得住資產負債表的殘酷現實，AI晶片巨頭輝達正試圖解決這個日益尖銳的融資瓶頸。
輝達上周一(10日)宣布與高盛、阿波羅、貝萊德、黑石、布魯克菲爾德及 KKR等金融巨頭聯手，籌建規模超過5000億美元的獨立融資平台，專門服務輝達驅動的AI基礎設施建設。
根據規劃，輝達可能為相關交易提供最高1250億美元(約佔總規模 25%)支持。高盛正與保險公司、銀行及資產管理機構接洽具體架構，其資產管理部門可提供初級資本與私人信貸，投資銀行部門則負責將債務配置給私人信貸基金，最終推向公開債券市場。這意味著客戶不用將龐大採購成本全數壓在自身資產負債表上，即可持續取得日益昂貴的輝達系統。
這項計畫的核心戰略意義在於，輝達試圖將GPU及全端AI系統轉化為「可投資的基礎設施資產類別」，融資與資產本身及使用綁定的收入掛鉤，而非過度依賴傳統供應商融資模式，這有望大幅擴大有能力部署超大規模AI聚落的客戶群體。
財報數據為此提供了強力背書，輝達2027財年第一季營收年增85%至816億美元，其中資料中心業務暴漲92%至752億美元。
對投資人而言，5000 億美元計畫若順利落地，可望透過消除資本獲取瓶頸進一步擴大可觸達市場。
但風險同樣不容忽視，輝達可能背負高達1250億美元的潛在支持責任，市場需密切關注融資項目品質、客戶信用狀況及實際保留風險部位。
輝達將在8月26日公布第二財季財報，屆時市場將聚焦資料中心增長、遠期需求指引及對融資架構的相關表態。若機構投資人真正將輝達硬體視為可融資基礎設施，AI支出週期可望顯著延長；反之，則可能引發「融資是否在人為支撐需求」的質疑。
paras_en: The AI arms race is facing a harsh reality: being able to afford chips does not necessarily mean being able to bear the weight of the balance sheet. Hicloud, a leading AI chip company, is trying to solve this increasingly acute funding bottleneck.

Hicloud announced on Monday (10th) that it has partnered with Goldman Sachs, Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, and KKR to build an independent financing platform with a scale of over $50 billion, dedicated to serving Hicloud's AI infrastructure construction.

According to the plan, Hicloud may provide up to $125 billion (approximately 25% of the total scale) in support for related transactions. Goldman Sachs is in talks with insurance companies, banks, and asset management institutions to finalize the structure, with its asset management department providing primary capital and private loans, and its investment banking department responsible for allocating debt to private loan funds and ultimately pushing it to the public bond market.

This plan's core strategic significance lies in Hicloud's attempt to transform GPU and full-stack AI systems into 'investable infrastructure asset categories', with financing tied to the assets themselves and the associated income, rather than relying too heavily on traditional supplier financing models. This could significantly expand the customer base capable of deploying large-scale AI clusters.
Financial data provides strong backing for this effort. Hicloud's first-quarter revenue for fiscal year 2027 increased by 85% to $8.16 billion, with data center business surging 92% to $7.52 billion.
For investors, the $50 billion plan, if successful, could further expand the addressable market by eliminating capital access bottlenecks.

However, risks cannot be ignored. Hicloud may bear a potential support responsibility of up to $125 billion, and the market needs to closely monitor the quality of the financing projects, customer creditworthiness, and actual risk retention positions.

Hicloud will release its second-quarter earnings on August 26, with the market focusing on data center growth, long-term demand guidance, and related statements on the financing framework. If institutional investors truly view Hicloud hardware as a financiable infrastructure, the AI spending cycle may be significantly extended; otherwise, it may raise questions about whether funding is artificially supporting demand.

items.title: Anthropic揭Claude Code「省錢6招」！善用快取、/clear降低Token成本
paras: Anthropic近日發布一篇部落格文章，針對開發者使用Claude Code時容易出現的Token浪費問題，整理出6項降低成本的實用技巧。
官方指出，Claude Code的使用成本不只取決於選用哪個模型，也與推理強度、上下文長度及提示快取是否命中密切相關；若缺乏上下文管理，同一項程式開發任務的成本可能出現數倍差距。
Anthropic建議，開發者完成一項任務後應立即使用「/clear」清除對話，避免前一項工作的檔案內容、指令輸出與探索過程持續留在上下文中，並在開始工作時就確定模型與推理強度，減少後續切換造成的快取失效。

Anthropic列6招降低Claude Code成本


在不同任務之間執行「/clear」，避免把之前無關的上下文繼續送到模型，進而減少Token消耗。
開始工作前，先確定好模型和推理強度，因為中途更改其中任何一個，都可能導致提示詞快取失效，進而增加Token成本。
不要只寫出檔名，而是直接用「@」提及文件，使檔案會直接附加到訊息中，省去一次Read調用，並避免Claude再去搜尋檔案。
對輸出冗長的指令加上靜默參數，或把指令交給子代理執行。因為命令輸出會像檔案一樣加入對話，並且在整個會話期間都會保留。
在新會話開始時執行一次「/context」。它會顯示目前載入的內容（例如 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 工具定義），方便用戶刪除不必要的內容。
暫時離開鍵盤前執行「/compact」。提示詞快取通常一小時後就會過期，而在快取仍然有效時進行對話壓縮，成本要低得多。


Claude Code成本關鍵在Token如何被計算

Anthropic也進一步說明Claude Code背後的Token消耗機制。每次使用者發出指令時，模型首先需要進行「預填充」，讀取系統提示詞、CLAUDE.md、使用者訊息及過往對話等輸入內容；接著進入「解碼」（decode）階段，產生模型回覆、思考內容及工具呼叫等輸出。
兩者的運算方式並不相同。預填充會一次處理輸入內容，而解碼則是逐個Token產生輸出，因此輸出Token的成本高於輸入Token。
模型本身則決定每個Token的價格，而推理強度會影響Token使用量。
Anthropic指出，推理強度越高，模型需要產生的思考Token越多，因此開發者不應在所有任務上都使用最高推理強度，而應根據工作的複雜程度選擇合適的模型與設定。

提示快取成為降低成本的重要工具

在Claude Code的成本結構中，提示快取是另一個關鍵因素。
Claude Code的請求通常會包含相同的前綴，例如系統提示詞、工具定義、CLAUDE.md以及既有對話歷史。如果下一次請求的前綴內容與前一次完全一致，系統可以直接使用先前的計算結果，而不必重新處理全部內容。
Anthropic指出，快取讀取只要正常輸入價的0.1倍，可以直接省掉90%。雖然首次寫入快取需要較高成本，但之後的請求可以持續利用既有快取。
不過，快取並非永久有效，而且必須維持連續匹配。Anthropic列出幾種可能導致快取失效的情況，包括切換模型、改變推理強度、開啟或關閉Fast mode、使用「/compact」重新整理對話、快取逾期，以及長時間後恢復舊會話。
其中，模型與推理強度的切換尤其值得注意。Anthropic指出，不同模型各自擁有獨立快取，因此從一個模型切換到另一個模型後，原本的對話歷史可能需要重新進行預填充；推理強度同樣屬於快取條件之一。
此外，Anthropic也提醒使用者注意「opusplan」模式。由於該模式會在不同階段切換模型，因此進入或離開相關模式都可能造成快取失效，頻繁切換可能增加額外成本。

對話越長，累積成本也越高

即使成功利用快取降低重複處理成本，Anthropic仍提醒，對話本身持續膨脹仍會增加Token使用量。
Claude每讀取一個檔案、執行一次指令，都可能將相關內容加入對話歷史。隨著工作輪數增加，後續請求需要攜帶的上下文也會越來越長。
Claude Code設有機制處理過大的命令輸出：當輸出超過一定長度時，內容會被寫入暫存檔案，而對話中只保留摘要。不過，較短但仍然龐大的輸出仍可能直接留在上下文中。
例如測試工具產生大量測試結果，即使沒有超過系統設定的門檻，這些內容仍可能持續佔據後續對話空間。
因此，Anthropic再次強調，讓命令保持精簡、將大型工作交給子代理，以及適時清除或壓縮對話，都是降低上下文膨脹的重要方式。
除了「/clear」與「/compact」之外，Anthropic也提到「/rewind」。如果最近幾輪對話出現偏離，可以利用「/rewind」移除後續內容，同時保留較早的對話與快取狀態。

AI程式開發開始出現「Token管理」能力

從Anthropic整理的這些技巧可以看出，Claude Code的使用效率已不只是模型能力或程式設計技巧的問題，如何管理上下文、控制輸出、維持快取及選擇適當推理強度，也逐漸成為影響開發成本的重要因素。
對開發者而言，真正需要避免的並非單次使用大量Token，而是在長時間、多輪次的工作流程中，讓無關的上下文不斷累積，並因模型或設定切換導致原本可以重複利用的快取失效。
Anthropic此次公布的6項建議，核心邏輯也相當明確：讓每一次請求只攜帶真正需要的內容、讓能夠快取的內容持續命中，並將不必要的大量輸出隔離在主對話之外。對於高頻率使用Claude Code的開發者而言，這些操作將直接影響相同工作量下的Token消耗。

items.title: 距發表還一個月！電商不怕臨時改模 搶先開賣折疊iPhone殼  配件商打什麼算盤？
items.title_en: Apple's Foldable iPhone Looms, but Accessories Sellers Are Already Racing to Market
paras: 距蘋果首款折疊iPhone與iPhone 18系列正式亮相還有一個月左右，但電商平台上的「配件搶跑」已開跑，不少店家直接以「iPhone Fold」、「iPhone Ultra」為關鍵字上架折疊手機殼，未發布的iPhone 18系列保護殼、鋼化膜也同步現身，部分商品甚至按機型、材質、款式細分完畢。
《每日經濟新聞》報導，當記者以消費者身份詢價，商家多不願透露數據來源，只強調「工廠包數據、按數據開模」「確定可適配」，若日後改模會補發，但一款手機殼從開模、打樣到備庫存，本就牽動整條供應鏈，未發布就量產，本質是場高風險押注。
長期經營蘋果生態配件的業內人士表示，第三方廠商慣例會提前三個月備戰，搶的是新機上市首波「買機必買殼」的窗口，等蘋果發表再開發，黃金流量早已過去。資訊來源則不只靠官方，量產階段供應鏈外溢、機模流出、渲染圖與產業爆料，都足以讓成熟廠商憑尺寸、鏡頭位、按鍵佈局先行開模。
報導指出，今年還多了一個特殊變量，蘋果印度核心代工廠塔塔電子6月遭勒索攻擊，超20萬份、630GB機密文件(含主板圖紙、晶片參數、真機測試片)流入暗網，被稱為蘋果史上最嚴重洩密事件，新德里已介入調查，這讓配件廠能拿到的「公開情報」比往年更紮實。
不過，風險也更高。直板iPhone迭代多年，手機殼廠有經驗累積，折疊螢幕涉及鉸鏈、機身厚度、開合結構與螢幕形態，任一關鍵尺寸變動都可能讓前期開模作廢重來，也就是說折疊款「搶跑」賭注遠大於Pro機種。
知情人士透露，蘋果擬於下月只發表兩款高階Pro與首款折疊 iPhone，2027上半年再把標準版與SE整合發布，形成「Pro 秋發、基礎款春發」的拆分節奏。對配件產業鏈而言，過去一年一次秋季集中備貨，未來可能拆成多個時間窗口，從「一年一站集中搶跑」轉向「長周期、高頻接力」。
搶跑看似只是電商常態，實則映出蘋果保密防線鬆動、供應鏈情報商品化，以及 iPhone 產品節奏重組三股力量交疊。新機還沒露面，圍繞它的千億配件生意，已經先跑完了第一圈。
paras_en: Just a month before Apple's first foldable iPhone and iPhone 18 series are set to debut, e-commerce platforms have already seen a rush of 'accessory pre-sales.' Many sellers have listed foldable phone cases under keywords like 'iPhone Fold' and 'iPhone Ultra,' with some even offering cases for the yet-to-be-released iPhone 18 series and screen protectors.

According to a report by the Daily Economic News, when reporters inquired about prices as consumers, many sellers refused to disclose their data sources, only stating that they had 'factory data' and 'opened molds based on data.' If the design were to change later, they would issue a recall, but one phone case from mold opening to inventory storage is a high-risk gamble.

Industry insiders who have long operated in the Apple ecosystem noted that third-party manufacturers typically prepare three months in advance to secure a head start on the initial 'buy-a-phone-buy-a-case' window. They wait for Apple's official release before developing new products, as the golden opportunity has already passed.

The information source is not limited to official channels. During the production stage, supply chain leaks, prototype designs, and industry rumors can all provide enough information for mature manufacturers to develop cases based on dimensions, camera placement, and button layouts.

This year, there is an additional variable: Apple's Indian core manufacturing partner, Tata Electronics, was hit by a ransomware attack in June, resulting in over 200,000 leaked files (including motherboard diagrams, chip parameters, and real-machine test pieces) on the dark web, dubbed the most severe data breach in Apple's history. New Delhi has intervened in the investigation, giving accessory manufacturers more substantial 'public information' than in previous years.

However, the risks are higher. The flat iPhone has undergone numerous iterations, giving case manufacturers valuable experience. The foldable screen involves hinges, body thickness, opening and closing structures, and screen shape, making any key dimension change potentially render pre-made molds obsolete. In other words, the 'pre-sale' gamble for foldable cases is much greater than that for Pro models.

Sources close to the matter revealed that Apple plans to release only two high-end Pro models and the first foldable iPhone in the coming month, with standard and SE models to be released in the first half of 2027, forming a 'Pro autumn release, basic model spring release' schedule. For the accessory industry, this means a shift from 'one-time concentrated pre-sales' to 'long-cycle, high-frequency relay' production.

items.title: 美銀曝最優「AI泡沫交易」：建議同時做多「傲慢」與「偏見」
items.title_en: BofA Reveals Top "AI Bubble Trade": Go Long Both "Arrogance" and "Bias"
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮持續之際，美銀證券首席策略師Michael Hartnett認為，當前市場的最佳交易策略並非單押AI，而是同時做多「傲慢」（AI科技龍頭）與「偏見」（遭市場冷落的資產），藉此掌握名目GDP泡沫進入最後階段時可能出現的雙向行情。
美銀最新報告顯示，美銀牛熊指標上週由9.7小幅降至9.3，仍處於極度看多區間，但「賣出」訊號持續有效。
與此同時，近期資金流向出現明顯分化，科技股遭遇7週來最大單週資金流出，黃金則吸引今年1月以來最大單週資金流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，比特幣則下跌近28%。
美銀指出，現在市場仍相信「不要買債券、不要押美元、繼續買AI」，因為AI是最強成長主題，而且市場認為政策制定者不會輕易讓股市崩盤。
但該行提醒，未來如果美債殖利率繼續飆升、選民對生活成本更加不滿，或市場多頭持倉過度集中，都可能讓AI牛市開始失去上行動能。

AI「傲慢」搭配資產「偏見」　美銀提出雙向布局策略

Hartnett認為，從過往資產泡沫經驗來看，最佳的泡沫交易方式，是同時做多代表AI科技本身的「傲慢」，以及市場長期冷落、可能在名目GDP最終衝頂階段受惠的「偏見」資產。
美銀援引歷史案例指出，1999年網路泡沫以及2007至2008年次貸危機期間，都曾出現被市場忽視的資產在主導泡沫接近頂峰前，受惠於資金外溢的情況。
以目前市場環境來看，美銀認為「消費類股」最可能重現這種走勢。
另一方面，美銀建議放空AI相關債券，因為AI資本支出規模已超過1兆美元，加上企業淨現金流為負，未來可能面臨大量發債需求。
美銀指出，自5月26日牛熊指標首次出現賣出訊號以來，標普500指數仍累計上漲4%，MSCI全球指數也上漲3%。
該行提醒，市場持倉過度集中可能打亂牛市節奏，但真正要終結多頭行情，需要三項條件同時出現，包括持倉過度集中、企業獲利預期過於樂觀，以及政策轉向緊縮。
不過，目前這三項因素尚未同時成立。
從歷史表現來看，美銀牛熊指標成立以來共出現17次賣出訊號，全球股市在訊號出現後2至3個月平均下跌2%至3%，命中率約60%，最大回撤幅度則介於15%至20%。

黃金、大宗商品吸金　科技股出現7週最大流出

值得注意的是，近期資金流向進一步反映市場偏好的轉變。
上週，黃金基金單週淨流入63億美元，創今年1月以來最大單週流入；大宗商品今年以來總報酬率達58.9%，在各類資產中居首，其中原油今年以來上漲43%。
相較之下，科技基金上週淨流出12億美元，創7週以來最大單週流出。歐洲股票基金則吸引12億美元淨流入，創今年2月以來最大流入規模；南韓股票基金也連續第7週出現資金淨流入。
固定收益市場同樣出現資金回流。投資級債券單週吸引106億美元，創5週來最高；新興市場債券則流入14億美元，創7週來最高。現金類資產單週吸金254億美元。

美銀私人客戶股票配置創新高　現金比重降至紀錄低點

美銀私人客戶數據顯示，目前管理資產規模達4.7兆美元，其中股票配置比重升至66.4%，創歷史新高；債券配置降至17%，為2022年3月以來最低；現金配置則降至9.4%，創有紀錄以來最低水準。此外，股票單週淨流入規模也創2022年9月以來最大。
債券配置方面，私人客戶正略微拉長持有期限。今年以來，2年至10年期美國國債配置增加15%，而期限短於1年的國庫券配置則自去年11月以來減少逾30%。不過，30年期長債仍未受到青睞。
過去4週，私人客戶透過ETF買進日本債券、市政債券及抗通膨債券，同時減持新興市場債務、公用事業與金融類股ETF。
美銀同時警告，美國國家債務即將突破40兆美元，預估到2029年7月可能達到50兆美元。
過去12個月，美國聯邦政府利息支出已達1.4兆美元，在5年期美債殖利率降至3.25%以下之前，相關成本仍將持續增加。
與此同時，美國30年期國債以5.126%的殖利率完成發行，創25年來最高水準，但美股當天仍同步創下歷史新高，顯示市場「避開債券」的交易邏輯仍然有效。
值得注意的是，儘管2026年整體殖利率走高，REITs、小型股、生技股及區域銀行等過去受到冷落、對利率較敏感的資產近期反而開始跑贏大盤。
美銀認為，這可能反映市場已提前押注殖利率見頂。
報告認為，美日近期的匯率干預已向市場釋放訊號，顯示美國政府不希望10年期美債殖利率突破5%。
策略師預期，核心CPI在美國期中選舉前可降至2.1%至2.6%，屆時聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）可能透過Jackson Hole演說及9月利率會議釋放「任務完成」的訊號，再配合日本央行升息，進一步限制美債殖利率的上行空間。

黃金與香港地產成「避美元」交易選項

在「避開美元」的布局上，美銀提出兩項交易方向。
首先是做多黃金，將黃金視為因應美元貶值、債券市場崩跌及資產通膨的對沖工具，而近期黃金基金大幅吸金也反映市場對此交易的需求。
另一項策略則是布局香港房地產。美銀以「買進被羞辱的資產、賣出傲慢資產」概括這項交易邏輯。恒生地產指數目前處於約30年前的水準，估值約為12倍本益比。
美銀認為，亞洲正進入過去40年來第3輪長期多頭行情，主要由日本、南韓科技產業與中國AI共同推動。
與此同時，香港則可能受惠於杜拜的地緣政治吸引力與新加坡的稅務優勢相對減弱。

美國期中選舉成AI牛市關鍵政治變數

美銀將11月3日美國期中選舉視為影響市場後續走勢的重要事件。報告指出，如果共和黨守住參議院，且德州州長Greg Abbott成功連任，AI領軍的風險資產行情可能在2027年進一步加速。
反之，如果民主黨在11月取得參議院控制權，或拿下德州州長席位，股市、美元與債券殖利率可能在年底前出現超過10%的跌幅。
其中，德州州長選舉被美銀視為「負擔能力」與「AI資料中心」政策方向之間的選擇。
目前德州已有335座資料中心，另有247座正在規劃興建。Abbott近期宣布暫停資料中心擴張，反映選民對能源電網穩定性與生活成本的疑慮。
此外，美銀也關注後續幾項重要政策時程，包括：

8月28日聯準會主席華許在Jackson Hole的演講、
9月16日聯準會利率會議，
以及9月18日日本央行會議。


市場目前對聯準會升息的機率估計為35%，日本央行升息機率則為74%。
paras_en: Amid the ongoing AI investment frenzy, BofA Securities chief strategist Michael Hartnett says the best current market trade isn’t a pure AI bet but a simultaneous long on "Arrogance" (AI‑tech leaders) and "Bias" (assets shunned by the market), to capture the two‑way moves that may appear as the nominal‑GDP bubble reaches its final stage.
BofA’s latest report shows its bull‑bear index slipped slightly from 9.7 to 9.3 last week, still deep in the ultra‑bullish zone, but the "sell" signal remains active.

At the same time, recent fund flows have diverged sharply: tech stocks suffered the biggest weekly outflow in seven weeks, while gold attracted the largest weekly inflow since January; commodities have posted a YTD total return of 58.9%, and Bitcoin has fallen nearly 28%.
BofA notes the market still believes "don’t buy bonds, don’t short the dollar, keep buying AI" because AI is the strongest growth theme and policymakers are seen as unlikely to let equities crash.

The bank warns, however, that if U.S. Treasury yields keep soaring, voters grow more dissatisfied with living‑costs, or bullish positions become overly concentrated, the AI bull market could lose its upward thrust.

Hartnett argues that history shows the best bubble‑trade approach is to go long on the "Arrogance" representing AI technology itself and on "Bias" assets that the market has long ignored but could benefit when nominal GDP peaks.
BofA cites past bubbles – the 1999 internet boom and the 2007‑08 sub‑prime crisis – where overlooked assets gained as capital spilled over just before the bubble’s peak.
Given today’s environment, BofA believes "consumer stocks" are the most likely to repeat that pattern.
Conversely, BofA recommends shorting AI‑related bonds because AI cap‑ex now exceeds $1 trillion and corporate net cash flow is negative, likely prompting heavy debt issuance.
Since the bull‑bear index first gave a sell signal on May 26, the S&P 500 has risen 4% and the MSCI World index 3% cumulatively.

The bank cautions that overly concentrated bullish positions could disrupt the bull‑run rhythm, but ending the rally would require three conditions to line up: concentration, overly optimistic earnings forecasts, and a policy shift to tightening.
Those three factors have not yet materialised together.

Since the bull‑bear index was created, it has issued 17 sell signals; on average global equities fell 2‑3% in the 2‑3 months after each signal, a hit‑rate of about 60%, with maximum drawdowns of 15‑20%.
Gold and commodities have attracted inflows while tech stocks saw the biggest seven‑week outflow.
Last week gold funds netted $6.3 billion, the largest weekly inflow since January, and commodities have delivered a 58.9% YTD return, the highest among asset classes, with oil up 43% YTD.

By contrast, tech funds had a net outflow of $1.2 billion, the biggest weekly outflow in seven weeks. European equity funds drew $1.2 billion, the largest weekly inflow since February, and South Korean equity funds logged a seventh consecutive week of net inflows.
Fixed‑income also saw a reversal: investment‑grade bonds attracted $10.6 billion, a five‑week high; emerging‑market bonds saw $1.4 billion, a seven‑week high; cash assets pulled in $25.4 billion.

BofA private‑client data show assets under management now total $4.7 trillion, with equity weight up to 66.4% – a record high – while bond weight fell to 17%, the lowest since March 2022, and cash fell to 9.4%, a historic low. Weekly net equity inflows also hit the biggest level since September 2022.

On the bond side, private clients are modestly lengthening duration. YTD, allocation to 2‑10‑year U.S. Treasuries rose 15%, while holdings of sub‑1‑year Treasury bills have dropped more than 30% since November last year. Thirty‑year bonds remain unpopular.

Over the past four weeks, private clients bought Japanese bonds, municipal bonds and inflation‑linked bonds via ETFs, while trimming exposure to emerging‑market debt, utilities and financial‑sector ETFs.
BofA also warns that U.S. national debt is set to breach $40 trillion and could reach $50 trillion by July 2029.
In the past 12 months, federal interest outlays have hit $1.4 trillion, and costs will keep rising until the 5‑year Treasury yield falls below 3.25%.
Meanwhile, the 30‑year Treasury was issued at a 5.126% yield – the highest in 25 years – yet the U.S. equity market hit a record high that day, underscoring the continued “avoid bonds” trade logic.
Notably, despite higher overall yields in 2026, REITs, small‑caps, biotech and regional banks – assets previously shunned and rate‑sensitive – have recently outperformed the broader market.
BofA thinks this may reflect the market’s early bet that yields have peaked.
The report says recent U.S.–Japan FX interventions signal that Washington does not want the 10‑year Treasury yield to break 5%.

Strategists expect core CPI to fall to 2.1‑2.6% before the U.S. midterm elections, after which Fed Chair Kevin Warsh could signal “mission accomplished” at Jackson Hole and the September rate meeting, especially if the Bank of Japan raises rates, further capping Treasury yield upside.
Gold and Hong Kong property are presented as "avoid‑the‑dollar" plays.
BofA outlines two trade ideas: first, go long gold as a hedge against a weaker dollar, bond market collapse and asset inflation, noting the recent surge of inflows into gold funds.

Second, position in Hong Kong real estate, described as "buy the shamed asset, sell the arrogant asset"; the Hang Seng Property Index is near a 30‑year low, trading at roughly a 12‑times earnings multiple.
BofA believes Asia is entering its third long‑term bull market in four decades, driven by Japan, South Korean tech and Chinese AI.
At the same time, Hong Kong may benefit as Dubai’s geopolitical allure and Singapore’s tax advantage wane.

The U.S. midterm elections on November 3 are seen as a key political variable for the AI bull market; the report notes that if Republicans keep the Senate and Texas Governor Greg Abbott is re‑elected, AI‑led risk assets could accelerate further in 2027.
Conversely, if Democrats win the Senate or take the Texas governorship, equities, the dollar and bond yields could fall more than 10% by year‑end.
The Texas governor race is framed by BofA as a choice between "affordability" and "AI data‑center" policy directions.
Texas already hosts 335 data centers with 247 more planned; Abbott recently announced a pause on data‑center expansion, reflecting voter concerns over grid stability and living costs.
BofA also tracks several upcoming policy milestones: the Fed Chair’s Jackson Hole speech on August 28, the Fed rate meeting on September 16, and the Bank of Japan meeting on September 18.
The market currently estimates a 35% probability of a Fed rate hike and a 74% probability of a BoJ rate hike.

items.title: AI「偏空」隱憂現！美銀警告：基礎建設成本恐推升利率、使美股承壓
items.title_en: AI "Bearish" Risks Surface! Bank of America Warns Infrastructure Costs May Push Up Rates, Pressuring US Stocks
paras: 基於人工智慧（AI）能協助企業以更低成本提高產出、取代部分人力，進而降低薪資支出，AI長期被經濟學家與央行官員視為有助抑制通膨的新技術。然而，專家指出，這一切的發生可能還要「再等等」。
《Business Insider》報導指出，AI抑制通膨這項「長期利多」可能尚未到來。與此同時，AI基礎建設快速擴張所帶來的成本，反而已開始對物價形成上行壓力。
美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）報告於上週三（12日）公布後，相關跡象更加明顯。數據顯示，電腦價格單月上漲3.5%，軟體價格過去一年則大漲約40%。
美國銀行(BAC-US) 近日指出，再加上資料中心爭相取得電力所推升的能源成本，以及企業將AI導入成本轉嫁給消費者，AI開始呈現出推升通膨的特徵。
美銀經濟學家Stephen Juneau表示，AI不僅推高電子產品的投入成本，也正在帶來正向的財富效應，進而支撐消費需求。
他指出：「聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）一直強調的AI降通膨效應，恐怕還得再等一段時間。」
分析指出，這對股市來說，從兩方面都令人擔憂，包括短期與長期利率。
就殖利率曲線短端而言，AI推升通膨將使利率政策更加複雜。通膨越高，聯準會面臨的升息壓力就越大，可能進一步提高隔夜拆款利率。
報導指出，這將對經濟活動形成抑制，並可能拖慢企業獲利成長，而企業獲利正是支撐股市的重要因素。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye表示，AI基礎建設擴張不太可能造成一輪持續性的高通膨，但確實提高聯準會在9月會議上一次性升息的可能性。
另一方面，通膨升溫也可能推高長期債券殖利率。當投資人預期通膨將侵蝕資產實質價值，通常會要求更高的報酬率。
目前，美國10年期國債殖利率已升至4.64%，高於今年初的4.15%。
MRB Partners在一份給客戶的報告中表示，儘管影響長期利率的因素很多，但高額的投資支出正協助推升債券殖利率。該機構預期，長期殖利率仍將進一步走高，可能對股市造成不利影響。
MRB Partners全球策略合夥人Philip Colmar在報告中表示：「我們對美國國債的看空展望，最終將對美股構成問題。」
他進一步指出，自2020年以來，每當10年期美債殖利率出現明顯向上突破時，「股市都曾出現劇烈修正。」
paras_en: Based on AI’s ability to help companies increase output at lower cost and replace some labor, thereby reducing wage expenses, AI has long been seen by economists and central bankers as a new technology that could help curb inflation.
Business Insider reports that the long‑term inflation‑reducing benefit of AI may not have arrived yet, and the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is already creating upward price pressure.

After the US July Consumer Price Index report was released last Wednesday (the 12th), the signs became clearer, showing computer prices rose 3.5% month‑over‑month and software prices jumped about 40% over the past year.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) recently noted that rising energy costs from data centers scrambling for power and companies passing AI implementation costs onto consumers are giving AI an inflation‑raising character.
Bank of America economist Stephen Juneau said AI not only raises input costs for electronic products but also creates a positive wealth effect that supports consumer demand.
He added, “The Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s emphasis on AI’s deflationary impact may still require more time before it materializes.”
Analysts say this worries the stock market from two angles: short‑term and long‑term rates.

On the short end of the yield curve, AI‑driven inflation makes monetary policy more complex; higher inflation increases pressure on the Fed to raise rates, potentially lifting the overnight fed funds rate further.
The report notes this could dampen economic activity and slow corporate profit growth, which is a key driver of equity markets.

Sevens Report Research founder Tom Essaye said AI infrastructure expansion is unlikely to trigger a sustained high‑inflation episode but does raise the odds of a one‑time rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.
On the other hand, rising inflation could also push long‑term bond yields higher, as investors demand higher returns when they expect inflation to erode real asset values.
Currently, the US 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed to 4.64%, up from 4.15% at the start of the year.

MRB Partners told clients that although many factors affect long‑term rates, large investment outlays are helping lift bond yields, and the firm expects yields to keep rising, potentially hurting equities.
MRB Partners global strategy partner Philip Colmar said, “Our bearish outlook on US Treasuries will ultimately pose problems for US stocks.”
He further noted that since 2020, every time the 10‑year Treasury yield has made a clear upward breakout, the stock market has experienced a sharp correction.

items.title: 記憶體頂部提前？三星、SK海力士遭多家券商下調目標價 價差最多達200萬韓元
items.title_en: Memory Top Seen Ahead of Schedule? Samsung, SK Hynix Downgraded by Multiple Brokerages
paras: 南韓記憶體雙雄三星電子與SK海力士近期遭多家本土券商下修目標價，市場對「記憶體晶片週期是否已過頂」判斷出現明顯分歧。
未來證券以「週期頂峰可能早於預期」為由，將三星股價目標價從39萬韓元砍至35萬，未來資產證券亦從55萬降至37萬，信韓投資從59萬降至45萬，三星證券從50萬降至40萬，唯獨KB證券堅持「供給短缺至少再持續3年」，維持60萬韓元目標價不動。
市場對SK海力士的分歧則更劇烈。未來資產7月29日將目標價從420萬韓元大砍至280萬，信韓投資由420萬降至270萬，NH投資從410萬降至340萬，大信從390萬降至320萬，三星證券從350萬降至300萬，但韓國投資證券逆勢從380萬上調至470萬韓元。目前各家對SK海力士目標價最低270萬、最高470萬，落差達200萬韓元。
空方邏輯集中在通用DRAM/NAND價格居高位、手機與PC採購轉保守，加上2027年原廠擴產釋放供給，擔憂景氣提前見頂。
市場多方則押注AI伺服器與HBM長協(LTA)訂單鎖住需求，供給端受良率與產能爬坡限制，短缺格局短期難解。即便目標價下修，多數券商仍保留「買入」評級，顯示下修的是估值乘數，而非否認AI記憶體中長線成長性。
這波調整自7月底SK海力士財報後加速，反映資本市場正從「漲價週期」框架切換到「AI資本開支可持續性」框架，短期目標價亂流不改產業核心變數，HBM出貨節奏與2027年供給實際落地速度，才是決定三星、海力士下一波段估值的關鍵。
paras_en: South Korean memory duopoly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have recently been downgraded by multiple local brokerages, with the market showing a clear divergence in judgment on whether the memory chip cycle has peaked.

Future Securities downgraded Samsung's target price to 3.5 million won from 3.9 million, citing 'peak cycle may come earlier than expected.' Future Asset Securities also downgraded it to 3.7 million from 5.5 million, Shinhan Investment to 4.5 million from 5.9 million, Samsung Securities to 4 million from 5 million, while KB Securities maintained its 6 million won target price, citing 'supply shortage to last at least 3 years'.

The divergence in judgment on SK Hynix is even more pronounced. Future Asset Securities downgraded its target price to 2.8 million won from 4.2 million on July 29, Shinhan Investment to 2.7 million from 4.2 million, NH Investment to 3.4 million from 4.1 million, Daesung to 3.2 million from 3.9 million, Samsung Securities to 3 million from 3.5 million, but Korea Investment Securities upgraded it to 4.7 million from 3.8 million. The current target prices for SK Hynix range from 2.7 million to 4.7 million, with a difference of 2 million won.
The bearish logic centers around high prices for DRAM/NAND, conservative smartphone and PC purchases, and the release of supply in 2027, with concerns about the economy peaking ahead of schedule.

The market, on the other hand, is betting on AI server and HBM long-term orders locking in demand, with supply-side constraints from yield rates and production capacity, making it difficult to resolve the shortage in the short term. Despite the downgrades, most brokerages still maintain a 'buy' rating, indicating that the downgrades are a matter of valuation multiples rather than denying the long-term growth potential of AI memory.

This round of adjustments has accelerated since the end of July, reflecting the capital market's shift from the 'rising price cycle' framework to the 'sustainability of AI capital expenditure' framework. The short-term target price fluctuations do not change the core variables of the industry, and the HBM shipment rhythm and the actual supply landing speed in 2027 are the key to determining the next round of valuation for Samsung and SK Hynix.

items.title: 輝達5000億AI融資計劃藏隱憂？川普顧問示警「暗GPU」：AI算力過剩恐引爆投資危機
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正試圖與大型投資機構合作，將GPU從單純的硬體設備轉化為可融資、可產生收益的資產，以協助人工智慧（AI）基礎設施業者解決龐大的資本支出需求。不過，這項計畫也面臨來自川普政府圈內的風險警告。
美國總統川普科學與技術顧問委員會成員David Sacks近日在《All In Podcast》節目中指出，AI算力市場目前真正值得擔心的並不是需求不足，而是供給擴張過快。
他指出，一旦市場出現大量閒置GPU，也就是所謂的「暗GPU」（dark GPU），可能對整個AI基礎設施投資鏈造成重大衝擊。
Sacks以網路泡沫時期的「暗光纖」（dark fiber）作為類比。2000年代初，電信業者曾大舉鋪設光纖，但實際需求遠低於預期，導致大量光纖閒置，價格隨後崩跌。
Sacks認為，若AI資料中心建設速度超過實際算力需求，GPU市場可能重演類似情況。
他表示：「對我來說，最大的風險不在需求側，最大的風險是算力出現過剩、出現過度建設。」
Sacks警告，如果最終形成「暗GPU」，將對所有相關業者造成嚴重衝擊，尤其是那些在建設算力基礎設施時，以每瓦30至50美元現貨價格作為預期的業者。
這項價格估算與馬斯克此前對AI算力價值的說法有關。據報導，馬斯克曾在SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部電話會議中表示，AI算力價值約為每瓦30至50美元，並據此估算，如果能提供1GW算力，到2027年底可能帶來3,000億至5,000億美元營收。
然而，算力基礎設施業者Nebius隨後披露，其多年期雲端服務協議的年合約價值約為每MW 2,000萬至2,500萬美元。
換句話說，馬斯克所估算的價格可能反映短期協議中的溢價水準，而非整個產業的普遍定價。

資料中心建設阻力反而降低供給過剩風險

值得注意的是，Sacks雖然警告AI算力過剩可能造成市場崩潰，但他認為，目前資料中心擴建面臨的政治阻力，反而可能成為防止供給過剩的一道「保險」。
Sacks指出，如果大量業者同時搶進算力供應，最終造成供給過剩，市場就可能面臨崩潰。但目前資料中心建設本身就相當困難，加上各種政治阻力，使算力供給難以快速擴張。
他表示，正是這些阻力，可能讓AI算力供給相對於快速成長的需求維持在較低水準。換言之，資料中心建設的門檻越高，供給就越難在短時間內大幅增加，反而有助於降低「暗GPU」出現的可能性。

AI資本支出龐大　輝達尋求打通融資管道

Sacks同時說明輝達推動GPU金融化的原因。他認為，AI基礎設施業者目前面臨的資本支出規模，已經超出單靠股權與傳統債務融資可以輕易負擔的程度。
Sacks以馬斯克的擴張計畫為例指出，馬斯克預計明年新增約6至8GW算力，相關資本支出可能達3,000億至4,000億美元，而其公司近期透過股權與債務融資籌得約1,000億美元，仍存在龐大的資金缺口。
在這種情況下，Sacks認為，向GPU供應商取得「賣方融資」可能成為其中一種解決方案。
他指出，輝達執行長黃仁勳目前正建立一套信用額度，並透過大型銀行與私募股權機構，向下游買家提供融資管道。
這項計畫的核心概念，是讓GPU不再只是需要大量前期資本支出的硬體，而是轉變為具有金融屬性的資產。透過輝達提供殘值支持，GPU可以被納入融資架構，讓持有者得以利用其未來產生收益的能力取得資金。

items.title: 初期掉電快、後期很耐用！特斯拉Model Y一年跑4萬公里後 電池容量還有91%
items.title_en: Tesla Model Y's Battery Degradation: Initial Drop-Off, Then Long-Term Reliability
paras: 電動車車主最擔心電池「越用越短」，但最新實測數據顯示，電動車電池的衰減其實集中在初期，隨後便會趨於平緩。
根據《Insideevs》報導，美國網紅Andy Slye駕駛2026年式特斯拉Model Y Premium後驅版一年、行駛約4萬公里後，透過第三方服務Recurrent估算，電池健康度仍維持在91%左右，讓他直言「完全不擔心」。
這一發現與電池分析機構Voltest的研究吻合。Voltest指出，採用鎳基電池的長續航特斯拉車款，最明顯的容量衰減多發生前兩到三年或行駛8萬公里內，一旦度過初期階段，約90%的健康度便會成為穩定基準，後續衰減曲線將大幅趨緩。
Recurrent透過分析車輛回傳的電量狀態、預估續航、行駛里程、充電紀錄與溫度等數據，交叉比對同型車款得出結論。Slye平時主要在家中以交流電充電，僅偶爾使用Supercharger超級充電站，且車輛第一年都在氣候溫和的肯塔基州度過，並未長期暴露於會加速電池老化的高溫環境，這代表91%的數據並非來自頻繁快充或酷熱氣候的極端損耗。
Slye曾進行滿電至0%的完整續航測試，以高速公路車速實測跑出483公里，恰好符合預估值。他計算，若日常只充至80%，實際續航約386公里，對通勤與生活已綽綽有餘。他笑稱，自己本來就不喜歡一次開這麼遠。
實際案例也印證上述趨勢：一輛行駛三年的高里程Model 3計程車，電池容量仍保有88.5%，甚至一輛2015年式Model S P85D，在累積近25.7萬公里後，健康度還有約86%。
專家指出，早期衰減不代表未來10萬英里(約16萬公里)表現，電池壽命仍受駕駛習慣、氣候與充電頻率等多重因素影響，但對大多數車主而言，「初期掉電快、後期很耐用」的規律，無疑是一顆定心丸。
paras_en: Electric vehicle owners are often concerned that their car's battery will degrade over time, but recent data suggests that the initial drop-off in battery capacity is concentrated in the early stages, with a subsequent leveling off.

According to a report by Insideevs, American social media influencer Andy Slye drove his 2026 Tesla Model Y Premium rear-wheel drive for a year, covering approximately 40,000 kilometers, and using a third-party service called Recurrent, estimated that the battery health was still around 91%.

This finding is consistent with research by Voltest, a battery analysis company. Voltest notes that Tesla models with nickel-based batteries, which have a long range, experience the most significant capacity degradation within the first two to three years or within the first 80,000 kilometers. Once this initial period is passed, around 90% of the battery health becomes a stable baseline, with subsequent degradation curves becoming much flatter.

Recurrent analyzed the vehicle's returned energy state, estimated range, mileage, charging records, and temperature data to cross-reference with other models of the same type and draw conclusions. Slye typically charges his car at home using alternating current and only occasionally uses Supercharger fast-charging stations, and his car spent its first year in the mild climate of Kentucky, without prolonged exposure to high temperatures that can accelerate battery degradation.

Slye has performed a full-range test from 100% to 0% and achieved a range of 483 kilometers at highway speeds, exactly matching the estimated value. He calculated that if he only charged to 80%, the actual range would be around 386 kilometers, which is more than sufficient for daily commutes and living. He jokingly said that he didn't like driving that far anyway.

Real-world examples also confirm this trend: a three-year-old high-mileage Model 3 taxi car still has a battery capacity of 88.5%, and a 2015 Model S P85D with nearly 257,000 kilometers on the clock still has a battery health of around 86%.

Experts note that early degradation does not necessarily mean poor performance over the next 100,000 miles (approximately 160,000 kilometers), as battery lifespan is influenced by multiple factors, including driving habits, climate, and charging frequency. However, for most owners, the rule of thumb that 'initial drop-off is fast, but long-term reliability is good' is undoubtedly a reassuring one.

items.title: 川普突下令大砍美韓軍演！稱北韓「不具威脅」、與金正恩關係「良好」
items.title_en: Trump Orders Major Cut in US-South Korea Military Exercises, Says North Korea 'Not a Threat' and Has 'Good Relationship' with Kim Jong-un
paras: 美國總統川普週日（16日）在社群媒體發文表示，他已指示美國國防部大幅削減與南韓舉行的聯合軍事演習，並同時提到南韓曾拒絕參與針對伊朗的相關行動。
根據《路透》報導，在美韓演習預定開始前數小時，川普在社群平台Truth Social發文指出，儘管目前取消整場演習已經太晚，但他對美國先前同意參與這項演習一事「並不高興」。
年度美韓「乙支自由之盾」（Ulchi Freedom Shield）聯合軍事演習定於8月17日至27日舉行，約有1.8萬名南韓軍人參與。
南韓官員上週表示，為因應北韓不斷發展的軍事能力，此次演習預計將納入反制無人機、干擾GPS訊號及應對網路攻擊等作戰行動。
川普在社群媒體貼文中也提到，他與北韓領導人金正恩維持「非常良好的關係」。
川普寫道：「這些演習不僅成本高昂，其中很大一部分費用還由美國承擔（像往常一樣！），更會向一個國家傳遞完全不恰當且帶有敵意的訊號。」
他強調：「自唐納．J．川普擔任總統以來，這個國家（北韓）一直沒有對我們構成威脅，並且始終保持尊重。」
川普也提及南韓對美國與以色列與伊朗之間衝突的立場。
川普寫道：「雖然這多少有些無關（？），但我最近曾詢問南韓總統，他們是否願意加入我們對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國推動的去核化行動，而他們回答：『不用了，謝謝！』」
白宮尚未立即回應外界要求說明川普要求削減美韓軍事演習的進一步詢問。美國國防部也尚未立即作出回應。
平壤一再譴責美韓聯合軍事演習，稱其為準備入侵北韓的行動。南韓與日本軍方表示，北韓上週三從東部沿岸向日本海方向發射一枚彈道飛彈；就在6天前的8月6日，北韓也曾發射一枚類似的短程彈道飛彈。
美國軍方官員表示，曾與俄羅斯並肩參與入侵烏克蘭戰爭的北韓部隊，已從這場衝突中累積實戰經驗，包括日益廣泛運用的無人系統、電子戰及網路作戰等能力。
烏克蘭方面上週表示，俄羅斯對札波羅熱（Zaporizhzhia）一座鋼鐵廠發動彈道飛彈攻擊時，使用了北韓製飛彈，造成7名工人死亡，並迫使該鋼鐵廠暫停生產。俄羅斯在這起攻擊中也使用了「鋯石」（Zircon）高超音速飛彈。
paras_en: US President Trump tweeted on Sunday (16th) that he has instructed the US Department of Defense to significantly reduce the joint military exercises with South Korea, and at the same time mentioned that South Korea had previously refused to participate in related actions against Iran.

According to Reuters, Trump tweeted on the social platform Truth Social a few hours before the scheduled start of the US-South Korea exercise, saying that although the cancellation of the entire exercise is too late, he is 'not happy' about the US's previous agreement to participate in this exercise.
The annual US-South Korea 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' joint military exercise is scheduled to take place from August 17 to 27, with approximately 18,000 South Korean soldiers participating.

South Korean officials said last week that this year's exercise will include countermeasures against unmanned aerial vehicles, jamming GPS signals, and responding to network attacks, among other combat actions, in response to North Korea's continued development of military capabilities.
Trump also mentioned in his social media post that he has a 'very good relationship' with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
Trump wrote: 'These exercises are not only expensive, with a large part of the cost borne by the US (as usual!), but will also send a completely inappropriate and hostile signal to a country.'
He emphasized: 'Since Donald J. Trump took office, this country (North Korea) has never posed a threat to us and has always been respectful.'
Trump also mentioned South Korea's stance on US-Israel-Iran conflicts.

Trump wrote: 'Although this is somewhat irrelevant, I recently asked the South Korean president if they would join our efforts to promote nuclear disarmament against the Islamic Republic of Iran, and they replied: 'No, thank you!' '

The White House has not yet responded to external requests for further explanation of Trump's request to reduce US-South Korea military exercises. The US Department of Defense has also not yet responded.

Pyongyang has repeatedly condemned the US-South Korea joint military exercises, calling them a preparation for an invasion of North Korea. South Korean and Japanese military officials said that North Korea fired a ballistic missile towards the Sea of Japan from its eastern coast last Wednesday; just six days earlier, on August 6, North Korea also fired a similar short-range ballistic missile.

US military officials said that North Korean troops, who had fought alongside Russia in the invasion of Ukraine, have accumulated combat experience, including the increasing use of unmanned systems, electronic warfare, and network warfare capabilities.

Ukraine said last week that Russia used North Korean-made missiles in a ballistic missile attack on a steel plant in Zaporizhzhia, killing seven workers and forcing the plant to suspend production. Russia also used 'Zircon' hypersonic missiles in this attack.

items.title: 「光進銅退」時代來了！輝達CPO交換器正式出貨：功耗暴降80%、頻寬衝上409.6Tb/s
items.title_en: The Era of 'Optical Over Copper' Has Arrived! HUAWEI's CPO Interchangeable Module Officially Delivered: Power Consumption Drops 80%, Bandwidth Reaches 409.6Tb/s
paras: 輝達上週五(14日)透過官方社群帳號宣布，全球首款進入量產的200G/lane CPO乙太網路交換器系統「Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics」正式出貨，CoreWeave、Lambda 與甲骨文為首批採用客戶，該產品在今年5-7月進入生產階段，標誌著資料中心網路架構正式邁入「光進銅退」的新紀元。
Spectrum-X基於新一代 Spectrum-6交換晶片打造，採用共封裝光學(CPO)技術，將光學引擎與交換ASIC直接整合於同一模組內，電訊號傳輸路徑從傳統的 15 至 30 公分 PCB 走線縮短至毫米級。
相較於傳統可插拔收發器架構，光損耗從約22dB大幅降至4dB，訊號完整性提升64倍。單顆Spectrum-6晶片交換容量達 102.4Tb/s，為上一代兩倍；旗艦機型SN6800可配置為512個 800Gb/s或2048個200Gb/s埠，總頻寬高達409.6Tb/s，同時雷射數量減少75%、功耗降低80%，平均故障間隔時間提升十倍。
這項技術突破背後，是輝達與全球供應鏈的深度協同：台積電提供先進矽光子製程，矽品負責晶圓級與晶片級封測，Lumentum供應雷射晶片，天孚通信完成模組子組件組裝，鴻海則擔綱整機交換器系統組裝，輝達並在自有設施執行出貨前最終測試，確保產品良率與可靠性。
值得關注的是，輝達近月在CPO領域的投資動作頻頻。今年3月分別向Lumentum與Coherent各投資20億美元，並簽署多年供應協議，5月再跟康寧達成策略合作，透過最高 27 億美元投資在美新建三座先進工廠，短短三個月累計投資至少65億美元，顯示輝達將光互連技術視為下一代AI工廠的核心戰略。
隨著AI算力叢集從萬卡擴張至十萬卡、百萬卡規模，資料中心瓶頸已從單顆GPU算力轉向叢集互聯能力。市場研究機構數據顯示，今年全球CPO市場規模預計達20億美元，年增逾400%，高盛更預測2028年將衝上910億美元。
隨著輝達Vera Rubin平台量產持續推進，矽光互連可望成為標準配備，相關供應鏈景氣度持續看升。
paras_en: HUAWEI announced on Friday last week (14th) through its official social media account that the world's first 200G/lane CPO Ethernet network exchange system, 'Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics', has officially been delivered. CoreWeave, Lambda, and Oracle are the first batch of customers to adopt this product, which entered the production stage in May-July this year, marking the beginning of the era of 'optical over copper' in data center network architecture.

Spectrum-X is based on the new-generation Spectrum-6 exchange chip, using the CPO technology to integrate the optical engine and exchange ASIC directly into the same module. The transmission path of the electrical signal is shortened from the traditional 15-30 cm PCB line to millimeter-level.

Compared to traditional plug-and-play transceiver architectures, the optical loss has been significantly reduced from approximately 22 dB to 4 dB, with signal integrity improved by 64 times. A single Spectrum-6 chip can exchange 102.4Tb/s, which is twice that of the previous generation. The flagship model SN6800 can be configured with 512 800Gb/s or 2048 200Gb/s ports, with a total bandwidth of up to 409.6Tb/s, while reducing laser numbers by 75% and power consumption by 80%, and increasing average time between failures by ten times.

Behind this technology breakthrough is the deep collaboration between HUAWEI and the global supply chain: TSMC provides advanced silicon photonics processes, SilTerra is responsible for wafer-level and chip-level packaging, Lumentum supplies laser chips, and Foxconn completes module component assembly, while HUAWEI assembles the entire exchange system and performs final testing at its own facilities to ensure product yield and reliability.

Notably, HUAWEI has been actively investing in the CPO field in recent months. In March, it invested $2 billion each in Lumentum and Coherent, signing multi-year supply agreements, and in May, it reached a strategic cooperation with Corning, investing up to $2.7 billion to build three advanced factories in the US. In just three months, HUAWEI has invested at least $6.5 billion, demonstrating its vision of optical interconnect technology as a core strategy for the next-generation AI factory.

As AI computing clusters expand from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of cards, data center bottlenecks have shifted from individual GPU performance to cluster interconnect capabilities. Market research data shows that the global CPO market is expected to reach $2 billion this year, with a year-over-year growth of over 400%, and Goldman Sachs predicts that it will reach $9.1 billion in 2028.
With the continuous progress of HUAWEI's Vera Rubin platform, silicon photonics interconnects are expected to become standard equipment, and the supply chain outlook remains optimistic.

items.title: CNN：川普麻煩事還在增加
items.title_en: CNN: Trump’s Troubles Keep Growing
paras: 《CNN》指出，美國總統川普在伊朗戰爭問題上的麻煩越積越多，而且很多已經超出戰場和談判桌之外。
最近有如下一些動向：
日前報導的川普因伊朗潛在威脅而在土耳其祕密換飛機一事，讓人嚴重懷疑，這屆政府是不是拿工作人員和媒體記者當誘餌。這一爆料也削弱了政府關於伊朗能力已被大幅削弱的說法。
美國的彈藥短缺問題似乎也迫在眉睫。對於這一問題，有人在戰前就警告過川普。
越來越多跡象顯示，川普政府官員及盟友對這場戰爭感到厭倦，正在尋找或敦促尋找退出路徑。
「林肯號」航母因支援戰事而超長部署，有關航母上生活條件糟糕和官兵心理健康惡化的報導越來越多。
上述每一條都在削弱川普讓這場戰爭繼續下去的能力。戰爭已打到第六個月。川普堅稱沒感到時間壓力，但他黨內一些人恐怕不敢苟同，畢竟期中選舉正在臨近。
「換飛機」一事最有可能在這場本就不受歡迎的戰爭上再疊加一層醜聞。更重要的是，它動搖了政府「已在軍事上重創伊朗」的說法。
彈藥供應問題一直是個潛在巨大隱患。參謀長聯席會議主席丹·凱恩及其他軍方領導人在戰前就警告過川普：若伊朗戰爭打成持久戰，彈藥庫存會是個大問題。
川普當時預期的戰爭時間似乎要短得多，僅持續四到六周。但現實並未如他所願。越來越多的報導表明，凱恩的警告有根據，關鍵彈藥消耗巨大。美國軍方在衝突中已消耗近80%「薩德」反飛彈系統攔截彈。
凱恩已私下向川普的其他高級顧問表示，政府得給這場戰爭找個退出路徑，因為擺在桌面上的那些用來升級衝突的軍事選項可能會適得其反，單靠空襲也難以實現川普的目標。
還有跡象顯示，川普的鐵桿盟友也越來越擔心，這場戰爭會在2026年期中選舉上拖累共和黨。眾議院議長強生最近說：「我們得儘快了結此事。」《Fox News》主持人勞拉·英格拉哈姆也說：「時間不多了。」
戰爭拖長似乎還製造了另一重麻煩：疲勞、生活條件差、心理健康惡化正在困擾那些承擔作戰任務的美軍官兵。
paras_en: CNN reports that U.S. President Trump’s problems over the Iran war are mounting and many have already spilled beyond the battlefield and the negotiating table.
Recent developments include the following:

A recent report about Trump secretly swapping aircraft in Turkey due to a potential Iranian threat has raised serious doubts about whether the administration is using staff and journalists as bait. The revelation also undermines the government’s claim that Iran’s capabilities have been significantly weakened.
The United States’ ammunition shortage appears to be imminent, and someone warned Trump about this issue before the war began.
Increasing evidence shows that Trump administration officials and allies are growing weary of the war and are seeking—or urging the search for—an exit strategy.
The USS Lincoln aircraft carrier has been on an extended deployment to support the war, and reports of poor living conditions and deteriorating mental health among its crew are mounting.

Each of these points erodes Trump’s ability to keep the war going. The conflict is now in its sixth month. Trump insists he feels no time pressure, but some members of his party are unlikely to agree, especially with the midterm elections looming.
The aircraft‑swap incident is likely to add another scandal to an already unpopular war and, more importantly, it shakes the administration’s claim that Iran has been “militarily crippled.”

Ammunition supply has long been a potential huge risk. Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Dan Keen and other military leaders warned Trump before the war that if the Iran conflict turned into a protracted fight, ammunition stockpiles would become a major problem.

Trump had originally expected the war to be much shorter—only four to six weeks—but reality has not matched his expectations. More reports confirm Keen’s warning was warranted, as key munitions have been consumed at a massive rate. The U.S. military has already used nearly 80% of the interceptors for the THAAD missile‑defense system in the conflict.

Keen has privately told other senior Trump advisers that the administration must find a way out of the war, because the military options on the table to escalate the conflict could backfire, and air strikes alone are unlikely to achieve Trump’s objectives.

There are also signs that Trump’s staunch allies are increasingly worried the war will hurt the Republican Party in the 2026 midterm elections. House Speaker Johnson recently said, “We need to wrap this up as soon as possible.” Fox News host Laura Ingraham added, “Time is running out.”
The prolonged war appears to be creating another set of problems: fatigue, poor living conditions, and deteriorating mental health are plaguing the U.S. service members tasked with combat operations.

items.title: 1.66億押注記憶體晶片！陸MCU龍頭中微半導體上半年淨利接近翻倍 Q2季增134% 掀國產替代漲價潮
items.title_en: HK$1.66 billion bet on memory chips! China MCU leader Zhongtian Microelectronics sees net profit nearly double in H1, Q2 surges 134% driving domestic replacement price hike
paras: A股MCU龍頭中微半導周(16)日晚間交出今年上半年成績單，營收7.26億元(人民幣，下同)，年增44.01%，歸母淨利潤1.72億元，年增98.48%；扣非淨利更年增逾109%。單季來看，今年首季淨利0.51億元，Q2躍升至1.21億元，季增約134%，加權ROE由去年同期2.85%升至5.26%，經營現金流1.93億元、年增27.87%。
中微半導將業績高成來歸因於三股力道：AI端側、具身機器人與汽車電子拉貨；高研發投入推升32位元MCU與車規產品占比；「大客戶戰略」落地帶動標竿效應。
今年上半年，消費電子業務營收3.02億元、小家電2.13億元、工控(含無刷電機、大家電、機器人)1.91億元、汽車電子0.19億元，客戶名單納入一汽紅旗、長安、賽力斯、吉利、三花智控、石頭科技、大疆、美的、海爾等。
更關鍵的是產業面「量價齊升」。中微半導在調研中直言，MCU需求增速超過產能增速，部分晶圓產能被AI與記憶體擠佔，甚至出現負成長，供不應求倒逼漲價。
此前，國民技術已發函自2026年10月1日起部分MCU價格上調10%–20%，主因國際友商交期拉長、缺貨與國產替代需求疊加。
資本布局上，中微半導今年上半年完成對珠海博雅1.66億元投資交割，持股21.0016%成為第二大股東。博雅專注NOR Flash，雙工藝(ETOX+SONOS)涵蓋512Kb–2Gb，今年上半年營收2.28億元、利潤5700餘萬元；NOR Flash與MCU常在同一電路板承載啟動碼與固件，中微半導入股便補齊「MCU+存儲」組合方案，吃下記憶體回暖紅利。
股價方面，中微半導7月1日盤中觸及每股人民幣66.98元，創上市新高，年內最大漲幅109.6%，隨後回落，上周五(14日)收40.28元，總市值161.27億元。
市場人士指出，MCU漲價潮+AI端側滲透+記憶體協同，正把中國國產MCU從「週期復甦」推往「結構性擴張」，但後續仍看新產能釋放速度與漲價可否傳導至毛利率。
paras_en: Zhongtian Microelectronics (16) released its H1 results, with revenue of HK$7.26 billion, up 44.01% year-over-year, and net profit of HK$1.72 billion, up 98.48% year-over-year. Excluding non-recurring items, net profit increased by over 109%. In terms of quarterly performance, the company's net profit in Q1 was HK$0.51 billion, while in Q2 it surged to HK$1.21 billion, with a quarterly increase of approximately 134%. The weighted ROE rose from 2.85% in the same period last year to 5.26%, and operating cash flow was HK$1.93 billion, up 27.87% year-over-year.

Zhongtian Microelectronics attributed its strong performance to three driving forces: AI edge, human-machine robots, and automotive electronics; high R&D investment boosted the proportion of 32-bit MCUs and automotive-grade products; and the 'large customer strategy' has taken effect, driving a benchmark effect.

In H1, the company's consumer electronics business revenue was HK$3.02 billion, small appliances HK$2.13 billion, industrial control (including brushless motors, household appliances, and robots) HK$1.91 billion, and automotive electronics HK$0.19 billion. The company has added customers such as FAW Hongqi, Changan, Saic, Geely, Three Flowers Intelligent Control, Stone Technology, DJI, Midea, and Haier to its list.

More importantly, the industry's 'quantity and price rise together'. Zhongtian Microelectronics said in its research that MCU demand growth has exceeded production capacity growth, with some wafer production capacity being occupied by AI and memory, even resulting in negative growth, and supply cannot meet demand, forcing prices to rise.

Earlier, Nationtech had sent a letter stating that from October 1, 2026, some MCU prices would be raised by 10% to 20%, mainly due to international friends' delayed delivery, lack of inventory, and added demand for domestic replacement.

In terms of capital layout, Zhongtian Microelectronics completed its HK$1.66 billion investment in Zhuhai Bo Ya in H1, holding a 21.0016% stake and becoming the second-largest shareholder. Bo Ya focuses on NOR Flash, with dual technologies (ETOX + SONOS) covering 512Kb to 2Gb, with H1 revenue of HK$2.28 billion and net profit of HK$57 million. NOR Flash and MCU are often carried on the same circuit board to enable code and firmware, and Zhongtian Microelectronics' investment has filled the 'MCU + storage' combination scheme, benefiting from the memory rebound.

In terms of stock price, Zhongtian Microelectronics touched a new high of HK$66.98 per share on July 1, with a year-to-date gain of 109.6%, and then retreated. Last Friday (14th), the closing price was HK$40.28, with a total market value of HK$16.127 billion.

Market people pointed out that the MCU price hike + AI edge penetration + memory coordination are driving China's domestic MCU from 'cyclical recovery' to 'structural expansion', but the subsequent speed of new capacity release and whether the price hike can be transmitted to gross margin still needs to be seen.

items.title: 報價30萬美元！AI開始「吃」倒閉公司聊天紀錄了
items.title_en: AI Bids $300,000 for Slack Chat Records of Defunct Startup
paras: 一家新創公司倒閉後，什麼東西最值錢？過去，答案可能是代碼、專利、客戶名單，或者是創始團隊。
如今，可能是Slack（一款類似於釘釘、飛書、企業微信的辦公協作軟體）聊天紀錄。
OpenAI、Anthropic背後的AI「數據工廠」Mercor，近期開始尋找倒閉或被收購的新創企業，購買內部數據集。這些數據不僅包括代碼庫，還包括Slack聊天紀錄、Google Drive、電子郵件以及Zoom線上會議錄音等。
6月底，AI Agent創業公司Warmly宣布將被HubSpot收購。八天後Warmly創始人馬克斯·格林沃德就在郵箱裡收到Mercor發來的郵件，對方希望購買或授權Warmly的Slack聊天、GitHub紀錄、Asana（一款項目與工作管理軟體）內容、Google Drive文件、員工會議轉錄等內部數據，報價最高達到30萬美元。
隨後幾天Warmly又陸續收到Mercor等AI數據公司多次類似接洽，但格林沃爾德全部拒絕。
AI數據公司購買書籍、新創企業代碼的消息屢見不鮮，但隨著AI巨頭加速開發能夠自主執行任務的AI Agent，AI的胃口不斷變大。網路公開內容、書籍、代碼已經不夠「吃」了。
數據公司Protege執行長鮑比·塞繆爾斯表示，AI實驗室已經基本刮完整個網路，現在需要的是人與人之間的真實互動。
當AI開始從「聊天機器人」變成真正意義上的「數位員工」時，不僅需要知道「答案是什麼」，更需要知道「人類到底是怎麼完成工作」。
比如，客戶提出問題時，人類員工會如何回覆；IT系統出現故障時，工程師如何一步步排查；發票出現問題時，財務人員怎麼處理；銷售人員又是如何在CRM系統裡更新客戶資料。甚至，一個員工面對軟體突然報錯時，會點擊哪裡、輸入什麼。
這些真實工作經驗很難從網上找到。
paras_en: What's most valuable after a startup goes bankrupt? In the past, it might have been code, patents, customer lists, or the founding team.
Now, it might be Slack chat records. OpenAI and Anthropic-backed Mercor, a data factory, has been looking for defunct or acquired startups to buy their internal data sets.
These data sets include not just code repositories, but also Slack chat records, Google Drive files, emails, and Zoom meeting recordings.

In June, AI Agent startup Warmly announced it would be acquired by HubSpot. Eight days later, Warmly founder Max Greenwald received an email from Mercor offering to buy or license Warmly's Slack chat, GitHub records, Asana content, Google Drive files, and employee meeting transcripts for up to $300,000.
Warmly received similar inquiries from Mercor and other AI data companies over the next few days, but Greenwald rejected them all.
News of AI data companies buying books and startup code is common, but as AI giants accelerate the development of autonomous AI agents, their appetite is growing.
Protege CEO Bobbie Seagren says AI labs have essentially scraped the entire internet, and now they need real human interactions.
When AI starts to become a true digital employee, it's not just about knowing the answers, but also how humans actually do work.

For example, when a customer asks a question, how do human employees respond? When an IT system fails, how do engineers troubleshoot it? When an invoice is problematic, how do finance personnel handle it?
Even the smallest details, like what an employee clicks on when a software crashes, are hard to find online.

Tensions in the Middle East and rising oil prices are supporting the dollar, but modest U.S. employment and inflation data have weakened the market’s case for a Federal Reserve rate hike next month. Money‑market participants now see about a 35% chance of a September Fed hike, putting pressure on the greenback. In addition, three sources familiar with the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) decision‑making say the BOJ could raise rates as early as September and may adopt a more aggressive pace than the current roughly twice‑a‑year schedule thereafter. This reflects BOJ concerns over inflation pressures from the Middle‑East conflict, strong global demand for artificial intelligence, and the yen’s weakening trend. The market now estimates an almost 80% probability of a September BOJ hike, which would create room for another increase in December and reinforce expectations that the BOJ could raise rates each quarter. Former Japanese Finance Ministry Vice‑Minister Mitsuhiro Furusawa also noted that the yen’s current level is clearly too low, which would raise import costs and hurt the economy, and said Japan could intervene jointly in the currency market at any time, hinting at a faster‑than‑expected rate hike to curb yen depreciation and weigh on the dollar‑yen pair near the 159.53 high.

items.title: 美伊緊張續升溫！伊朗議會通過反滲透法案 接受美以「敵對媒體」採訪最終判兩年
items.title_en: Iran Tensions Escalate: Parliament Passes Anti-Spying Law, Accepts US, Israel 'Enemy Media' Interviews, Faces 2-Year Sentence
paras: 伊朗議會週日(16日)以183票贊成通過一項反滲透法案，將接受美國、以色列或其資助媒體的採訪與相關通訊往來定為刑事犯罪，違者處6個月至2年監禁。 法案尚待憲法監護委員會審查始生效。
根據這項最新法案，受管制對象涵蓋美、以媒體及受其資助機構；與其他外媒採訪須事前通報情報部，與外國使館、組織未經外交部書面許可接觸者，處罰款並剝奪部分社會權利。
新法案另加重「受外國人指導監督的經濟犯罪」刑責，禁止未經批准向外人提供資訊，限制與非認可外國機構科學合作，而若政策或立法建議受外國情報機構指示、損及伊朗安全或獨立，最高可判30年監禁，由革命法院審理。
伊朗此舉延續去年跟以色列12天戰爭後的嚴打路線。本月伊朗攝影記者雅爾達·莫艾里即依類似條文被判15年，罪狀包括接受「敵對媒體」採訪、向美以兩國有關的組織提供照片。
分析人士指出，新法填補反滲透空白的同時，也把外媒採訪、學術交流與經濟活動進一步納入國安管轄，外界憂心記者與學界風險升高。
paras_en: Iran's parliament passed an anti-spying law on Sunday (16th) with 183 votes in favor, making it a criminal offense to accept interviews or related communications with US, Israeli, or media funded by them, punishable by 6 months to 2 years in prison. The law still needs to be reviewed by the Constitutional Supervision Committee before it takes effect.

According to the new law, the regulated subjects include US, Israeli media, and organizations funded by them; interviews with other foreign media must be reported in advance to the intelligence department, and contact with foreign embassies, organizations without written permission from the Foreign Ministry will be fined and have some social rights revoked.

The new law also increases the punishment for 'economic crimes guided and supervised by foreigners' and prohibits providing information to foreigners without permission, restricts scientific cooperation with unapproved foreign organizations, and if a policy or legislative proposal is directed by foreign intelligence agencies, harms Iran's security or independence, the maximum sentence can be 30 years in prison, tried by the Revolutionary Court.

Iran's move continues the tough line taken after the 12-day war with Israel last year. This month, Iranian photographer Yalda Moallemi was sentenced to 15 years under similar provisions, charged with accepting interviews from 'enemy media' and providing photos to organizations related to the US and Israel.

Analysts point out that the new law fills the gap in anti-spying laws while also bringing foreign media interviews, academic exchanges, and economic activities under national security control, causing concern among journalists and academics that the risks will increase.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元因降息預期升溫走低 本周仍終結連兩周跌勢
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Falls as Rate‑Cut Expectations Rise, Ending Two‑Week Decline This Week
paras: 美元周五(14日)走低，最新公布的經濟數據進一步促使市場重新調整對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。不過，受中東外交僵局推升油價，進而增加避險需求的帶動，美元本周仍終結連續兩周跌勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報99.67。本周上漲約0.1%。
這周市場主要關注美國關鍵通膨數據，以及周五公布的零售銷售數據，以尋找貨幣政策走向的線索。這些數據顯示價格壓力正在降溫、消費支出也有所放緩，加上上周公布的就業報告意外疲弱，使聯準會立即收緊貨幣政策的壓力有所減輕。
周三公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示，7月整體及核心通膨年增率均放緩。周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)也呈現類似趨勢，整體及核心指數年增速度均較為溫和。
美國人口普查局周五表示，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，至7,636億美元，遠低於市場預期的成長0.1%。核心零售銷售則月減0.3%，市場原先預期成長0.2%。
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams表示，「隨著汽油及其他能源價格上漲推高生活成本，消費者減少了非必要支出。6月個人儲蓄率更降至2022年年中以來最低水準。」
他指出，「細項數據其實沒有整體數字看起來那麼糟。加油站銷售下滑其實是好消息，因為這反映價格下降。此外，亞馬遜Prime Day今年提前至6月底舉行，而不是像去年一樣在7月舉行，也導致非店面零售銷售疲弱。但即使排除這些一次性因素，零售支出上個月仍然下滑。」
市場也相應調整了對聯準會利率走向的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率已升至約67%，高於一周前的近56%。升息1碼的機率則從一周前約44%降至接近33%。
Adams補充，「7月疲弱的零售銷售數據進一步降低了聯準會在9月下一次會議升息的機率。」
在CPI及PPI數據公布後，對利率敏感的美國公債殖利率周三、周四走低，因交易員大量買進債券。殖利率周五反彈，使10年期美債殖利率本周轉為上漲。不過，短天期的2年期美債殖利率本周仍下跌。
這周經濟數據對美元構成壓力，但油價上漲則抵銷了部分影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲1.7%，至每桶88.52美元，本周累計上漲4.5%。
油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗就關鍵水道荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權陷入僵局的影響。雙方均各自宣稱擁有這條重要水道的控制權，而德黑蘭則堅持華盛頓必須滿足包括停止各戰線敵對行動，以及解凍伊朗資產等要求，荷姆茲海峽才能重新開放。
美國目前正考慮無限期維持對伊朗的海上封鎖，結束衝突並恢復海峽正常航運的努力仍陷入停滯。通過這條航線的油輪數量已大幅減少，引發市場對石油供應中斷的擔憂。此外，伊朗支持的葉門「青年運動」(Houthis)在另一條重要海灣航運通道——曼德海峽(Bab el-Mandeb Strait)發動的船隻襲擊，進一步加劇相關疑慮。
日元本周貶值1%
其他主要貨幣方面，日元週五走強，但本周兌美元仍貶值約1%。
在華盛頓與東京於上月底進行歷史性聯合干預後，日元未能守住相關漲幅，近兩周持續兌美元走弱。
另一方面，歐元與英鎊本周均上漲，前者目前周漲幅為0.1%，後者上漲約0.3%。

paras_en: The dollar slipped on Friday (the 14th), as the latest economic data prompted the market to revise its expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. However, higher oil prices driven by a diplomatic deadlock in the Middle East boosted safe‑haven demand, allowing the dollar to break its two‑week losing streak this week.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 99.67, up about 0.1% for the week.

This week the market focused on key U.S. inflation figures and Friday’s retail sales data to gauge the direction of monetary policy. The numbers showed cooling price pressure and a slowdown in consumer spending, and together with last week’s unexpectedly weak jobs report, eased pressure on the Fed to tighten policy immediately.

Wednesday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed that both headline and core inflation year‑over‑year rates slowed in July. Thursday’s Producer Price Index (PPI) displayed a similar trend, with overall and core indices posting modest year‑over‑year growth.

The U.S. Census Bureau reported on Friday that July retail sales fell 0.6% month‑over‑month to $763.6 billion, far below the market’s expectation of a 0.1% increase. Core retail sales dropped 0.3% month‑over‑month, versus an anticipated 0.2% rise.

Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, said, “Higher gasoline and other energy prices have pushed up living costs, prompting consumers to cut back on non‑essential spending. The personal savings rate fell in June to its lowest level since mid‑2022.”

He added, “The granular data aren’t as bad as the headline numbers suggest. The decline in gas‑station sales is actually good news because it reflects lower prices. Amazon’s Prime Day was moved up to the end of June this year instead of July, which also contributed to weaker non‑store retail sales. Even after stripping out these one‑off factors, retail spending still fell last month.”

The market also adjusted its expectations for Fed rate moves. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September has risen to about 67%, up from roughly 56% a week earlier. The odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike fell from about 44% to near 33% over the same period.
Adams further noted, “Weak July retail sales data further reduce the likelihood of a rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.”

After the CPI and PPI releases, yields on rate‑sensitive U.S. Treasuries fell on Wednesday and Thursday as traders bought bonds in large volumes. Yields rebounded on Friday, turning the 10‑year Treasury yield into a weekly gain, while the short‑term two‑year yield continued to decline for the week.
This week’s economic data put pressure on the dollar, but the rise in oil prices offset part of that impact. Brent crude futures were up 1.7% at $88.52 a barrel, a weekly gain of 4.5%.

The oil price increase was mainly driven by a stalemate between the United States and Iran over control of the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Both sides claim authority over the waterway, and Tehran insists Washington must meet demands—including halting hostile actions on all fronts and unfreezing Iranian assets—before the strait can be reopened.

The United States is currently considering an indefinite maritime blockade of Iran, and efforts to end the conflict and restore normal shipping through the strait have stalled. The number of tankers using the route has dropped sharply, raising concerns about oil‑supply disruptions. In addition, Iran‑backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have attacked vessels in another key shipping lane, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, further heightening worries.
The yen depreciated about 1% this week.
Among other major currencies, the yen strengthened on Friday but still ended the week down roughly 1% against the dollar.
After a historic joint intervention by Washington and Tokyo at the end of last month, the yen failed to hold its gains and has weakened against the dollar for nearly two consecutive weeks.
Conversely, both the euro and the pound rose this week, with the euro up about 0.1% on a weekly basis and the pound gaining roughly 0.3%.

items.title: 川普政府再出手！美國要求歐盟拆除永續法規等非關稅壁壘
items.title_en: Trump Administration Acts Again! U.S. Demands EU Dismantle Sustainability Regulations and Other Non‑Tariff Barriers
paras: 美國周五(14日)再度向歐盟施壓，要求放寬企業永續與碳排相關法規，並履行先前承諾，確保這些規定不會對歐美貿易造成不當限制。不過，歐盟強調自身監管自主權不容談判，顯示雙方在關稅協議生效後，角力焦點正轉向非關稅貿易壁壘。
美國駐歐盟大使普茲德(Andrew Puzder)在社群平台X發文表示，歐盟應履行2025年7月在蘇格蘭坦伯利與美國總統川普進行貿易談判時作出的承諾。根據雙方架構協議，歐盟承諾確保《企業永續盡職調查指令》(CSDDD)與《企業永續報告指令》(CSRD)不會對跨大西洋貿易構成不當限制。
普茲德指出，這些法規的域外適用條款將損害美國企業與勞工，受影響的也不會只有美國。相關規定要求在歐盟營運的大型企業，包括美國公司，揭露其全球供應鏈對環境與社會造成的影響，其中涵蓋碳排放及勞動條件。
歐盟執委會發言人回應，美歐仍在就關稅與非關稅議題進行協商，歐盟也已向美方說明相關規範，並願意合作擴大雙邊貿易。不過，發言人強調，歐盟的法規架構及監管自主權均「不在談判範圍內」。
除企業永續規定外，華盛頓也要求歐盟修改碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)。該制度對未達歐盟碳排標準的進口商品徵收費用，美方認為這可能使美國出口商承受額外負擔。
知情人士預期，美歐可能在今年秋季發表聯合聲明，處理坦伯利協議中的非關稅議題。歐盟過去一年已放寬部分遭美方批評的政策，包括反森林砍伐法規及甲烷排放規定，但熟悉歐盟立場的人士表示，布魯塞爾目前無意進一步讓步。
歐盟去年也因企業與美國、卡達等政府反彈，縮減企業永續法規的適用範圍。去年12月通過的修正案將CSDDD限縮至最大型企業，合規期限延後兩年至2029年中；CSRD則僅適用於員工超過1,000人的企業，門檻遠高於原先的250人。
包括艾克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的美國企業仍要求更大幅度調整，甚至主張全面豁免外國公司。美方表示，雖肯定歐盟去年12月永續法規整合修正案的部分改革，但相關措施仍未充分解決美國對這兩項指令的疑慮。
paras_en: The United States pressed the EU again on Friday the 14th, demanding that it ease corporate sustainability and carbon‑related regulations and honor its earlier pledge to ensure those rules do not create undue restrictions on trans‑Atlantic trade. The EU, however, stressed that its regulatory autonomy is non‑negotiable, indicating that after the tariff agreement takes effect the focus of the dispute is shifting to non‑tariff trade barriers.

U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder posted on X that the EU must fulfill the commitment made in July 2025 during trade talks with President Trump in Tanfield, Scotland. Under the framework agreement, the EU pledged to ensure that the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD) and the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) will not constitute improper constraints on trans‑Atlantic commerce.

Puzder warned that the extraterritorial provisions of these regulations would harm U.S. companies and workers, and the impact would not be limited to the United States. The rules require large firms operating in the EU, including U.S. firms, to disclose the environmental and social impacts of their global supply chains, covering carbon emissions and labour conditions.

An EU Commission spokesperson responded that the U.S. and EU are still negotiating tariff and non‑tariff issues, that the EU has explained the relevant rules to Washington and is willing to cooperate to expand bilateral trade. However, the spokesperson stressed that the EU’s regulatory framework and supervisory autonomy are “outside the scope of negotiations.”

Beyond corporate sustainability rules, Washington also wants the EU to modify its Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). That system levies fees on imported goods that do not meet EU carbon‑emission standards, which the U.S. says could impose extra burdens on American exporters.

Informed sources expect the U.S. and EU may issue a joint statement this autumn to address the non‑tariff issues in the Tanfield agreement. Over the past year the EU has eased some policies criticized by the U.S., such as anti‑deforestation rules and methane‑emission standards, but insiders say Brussels is currently unwilling to make further concessions.

The EU also scaled back the scope of its corporate sustainability regulations last year after pushback from the United States, Qatar and other governments. An amendment passed in December limited the CSDDD to the largest firms, pushing the compliance deadline back two years to mid‑2029, while the CSRD now applies only to companies with more than 1,000 employees, a threshold far higher than the original 250‑employee benchmark.

U.S. firms, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), continue to demand far greater adjustments and even argue for a full exemption for foreign companies. The U.S. acknowledges some of the reforms in the EU’s December 2023 sustainability‑law integration amendment but says the measures still do not adequately address American concerns over the two directives.
